source.text: לֹֽא־יִ֠הְיֶה לַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם כָּל־שֵׁ֧בֶט לֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִשֵּׁ֧י יְהוָ֛ה וְנַחֲלָת֖וֹ יֹאכֵלֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: Not shall be to the priests the Levites, all [the] tribe of Levi, portion and inheritance with Israel; [the] fire offerings of Yahweh and his inheritance they shall eat.

en.L: There shall not be for the priests, the Levites, all the tribe of Levi, a portion or an inheritance with Israel; the offerings by fire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and his inheritance they shall eat.
en.B: The Levitical priests, and indeed the whole tribe of Levi, will receive no portion and no inheritance alongside Israel. They will eat from the food offerings of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, since these are their inheritance.
en.R: The priests and the whole tribe of Levi will not get a share of the land like the rest of Israel. Instead, they will live on the food offerings burned for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. That is their share.

es.L: No habrá para los sacerdotes, los levitas, toda la tribu de Leví, porción ni herencia con Israel; las ofrendas quemadas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y su herencia comerán.
es.B: Los sacerdotes levitas, y en verdad toda la tribu de Leví, no recibirán porción ni herencia junto con Israel. Comerán de las ofrendas quemadas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque esa es su herencia.
es.R: Los sacerdotes y toda la tribu de Leví no recibirán una parte de la tierra como el resto de Israel. En cambio, vivirán de las ofrendas quemadas en el fuego para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Esa es su parte.

fr.L: Il n’y aura pas pour les prêtres, les Lévites, toute la tribu de Lévi, de part ni d’héritage avec Israël ; les offrandes consumées par le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et son héritage, ils [les] mangeront.
fr.B: Les prêtres lévites, et même toute la tribu de Lévi, ne recevront ni part ni héritage avec le reste d’Israël. Ils se nourriront des offrandes consumées par le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car c’est là leur héritage.
fr.R: Les prêtres et toute la tribu de Lévi ne recevront pas de part du pays comme le reste d’Israël. Ils vivront plutôt des offrandes brûlées sur le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. C’est cela, leur part.

sw.L: Hakutakuwa kwa makuhani, Walawi, kabila lote la Lawi, fungu wala urithi pamoja na Israeli; sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na urithi wake ndivyo watakavyokula.
sw.B: Makuhani Walawi, naam, kabila lote la Lawi, hawatapata fungu wala urithi pamoja na Israeli. Watakula katika sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana hizo ndizo urithi wao.
sw.R: Makuhani na kabila lote la Lawi hawatapata sehemu ya nchi kama Waisraeli wengine. Badala yake, wataishi kwa sadaka zilizochomwa kwa moto kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hilo ndilo fungu lao.

vi.L: Các thầy tế lễ, là người Lê-vi, toàn thể chi tộc Lê-vi, sẽ không có phần hay sản nghiệp cùng với Y-sơ-ra-ên; họ sẽ ăn các của lễ dâng bằng lửa cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và sản nghiệp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ người Lê-vi, và cả chi tộc Lê-vi nữa, sẽ không nhận phần hay sản nghiệp như các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên khác. Họ sẽ ăn từ các của lễ dâng bằng lửa cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì đó là sản nghiệp của họ.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ và cả chi tộc Lê-vi sẽ không được chia phần đất như những người Y-sơ-ra-ên khác. Thay vào đó, họ sẽ sống nhờ các lễ vật người ta thiêu dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Đó là phần của họ.

ko.L: 레위인 제사장들, 곧 레위 지파 전체에게는 이스라엘과 함께 [받는] 몫이나 유산이 없을 것이다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불로 바치는 제물과 그분의 유산을 먹을 것이다.
ko.B: 레위인 제사장들과 레위 지파 전체는 이스라엘의 다른 지파들과 함께 몫이나 유산을 받지 못한다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불로 바치는 제물을 먹고 살 것이니, 그것이 그들의 유산이다.
ko.R: 제사장들과 레위 지파 사람들은 모두 다른 이스라엘 사람들처럼 땅을 나누어 받지 못합니다. 그 대신 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불에 태워 바친 제물로 먹고 삽니다. 그것이 그들의 몫입니다.

pt.L: Não haverá para os sacerdotes, os levitas, toda a tribo de Levi, porção nem herança com Israel; das ofertas queimadas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e da sua herança comerão.
pt.B: Os sacerdotes levitas, e de fato toda a tribo de Levi, não receberão porção nem herança junto com Israel. Eles comerão das ofertas queimadas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois essa é a herança deles.
pt.R: Os sacerdotes e toda a tribo de Levi não vão receber uma parte da terra como o resto de Israel. Em vez disso, vão viver das ofertas queimadas no fogo {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}. Essa é a parte deles.

am.L: ለካህናቱ ለሌዋውያን፣ ለሌዊ ነገድ ሁሉ፣ ከእስራኤል ጋር ድርሻና ርስት አይሆንላቸውም፤ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በእሳት የሚቀርቡትን መሥዋዕቶችና ርስቱን ይበላሉ።
am.B: ሌዋውያን ካህናት፣ በእርግጥም የሌዊ ነገድ ሁሉ፣ ከተቀረው እስራኤል ጋር ድርሻም ርስትም አይቀበሉም። {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በእሳት ከሚቀርቡት መሥዋዕቶች ይበላሉ፤ ርስታቸው እነዚህ ናቸውና።
am.R: ካህናቱና የሌዊ ነገድ ሁሉ እንደ ሌሎቹ እስራኤላውያን የመሬት ድርሻ አያገኙም። ይልቁንም {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በእሳት በሚቀርቡ መሥዋዕቶች ይኖራሉ። ድርሻቸው ይህ ነው።

hi.L: लेवीय याजकों का, लेवी के सारे गोत्र का, इस्राएल के साथ कोई भाग या निज भाग न होगा; वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आग में चढ़ाई गई भेंटें और उनका निज भाग खाएँगे।
hi.B: लेवीय याजकों को, बल्कि लेवी के सारे गोत्र को, इस्राएल के साथ कोई भाग या निज भाग नहीं मिलेगा। वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आग में चढ़ाई गई भेंटों में से खाएँगे, क्योंकि वही उनका निज भाग है।
hi.R: याजकों और लेवी के सारे गोत्र को बाक़ी इस्राएल की तरह ज़मीन का हिस्सा नहीं मिलेगा। इसके बजाय वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए आग में चढ़ाई गई भेंटों से अपना गुज़ारा करेंगे। वही उनका हिस्सा है।

ru.L: Не будет у священников-левитов, у всего колена Левия, части и надела с Израилем; огненные жертвы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} надел пусть они едят.
ru.B: Священники-левиты, и всё колено Левия, не получат доли и удела вместе с Израилем. Они будут питаться от огненных жертв {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, потому что это их удел.
ru.R: Священники и всё племя Левия не получат своей доли земли, как остальной Израиль. Вместо этого они будут жить за счёт огненных жертв, которые приносят {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Это их доля.

ja.L: 祭司たち、レビ人、すなわちレビ部族全体には、イスラエルと共に受ける割り当て地も嗣業もない。彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の火によるささげ物と、その嗣業を食べる。
ja.B: レビ人である祭司たち、すなわちレビ族全体は、イスラエルのほかの部族と並んで割り当て地や嗣業を受けることはない。彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}への火によるささげ物を食べる。それが彼らの嗣業だからである。
ja.R: 祭司たちとレビの部族全体は、ほかのイスラエルの人々のように土地の分け前を受けない。そのかわり、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のために焼いてささげられる物で生活する。それが、彼らの受ける分である。

uk.L: Не буде для священників-левитів, усього племені Левія, частки й спадщини з Ізраїлем; вогняні жертви {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і його спадщину вони їстимуть.
uk.B: Священники-левити, власне, усе племʼя Левія, не отримають частки й спадщини разом з Ізраїлем. Вони їстимуть із харчових жертв {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, бо це їхня спадщина.
uk.R: Священники й усе племʼя Левія не отримають частки землі, як решта Ізраїлю. Натомість вони житимуть із харчових жертв, які спалюють для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Це їхня частка.

id.L: Imam-imam orang Lewi, seluruh suku Lewi, tidak akan mendapat bagian dan milik pusaka bersama-sama Israel; korban-korban api-apian {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} dan milik pusaka-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, itulah yang akan mereka makan.
id.B: Imam-imam orang Lewi, bahkan seluruh suku Lewi, tidak akan mendapat bagian atau milik pusaka bersama Israel. Mereka akan makan dari korban-korban api-apian {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, sebab itulah milik pusaka mereka.
id.R: Para imam dan seluruh suku Lewi tidak akan mendapat bagian tanah seperti orang Israel yang lain. Sebaliknya, mereka akan hidup dari persembahan makanan yang dibakar bagi {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}. Itulah bagian mereka.

zh.L: 祭司，就是利未人，就是利未全支派，不可与以色列一同有分，也不可有产业；他们要吃{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的火祭和他的产业。
zh.B: 利未支派的祭司，以及整个利未支派，都不会和以色列其他人一同得着份地或产业。他们要靠{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的火祭为生，因为这就是他们的产业。
zh.R: 祭司和整个利未支派，不会像其他以色列人那样分到土地。他们要靠用火献给{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的祭生活。那就是他们应得的份。

tl.L: Ang mga pari, ang mga Levita, ang buong lipi ni Levi, ay hindi magkakaroon ng bahagi o mana na kasama ng Israel; ang mga handog na pinaraan sa apoy para {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}} at ang kaniyang mana ang kanilang kakainin.
tl.B: Ang mga paring Levita, at ang buong lipi ni Levi, ay hindi tatanggap ng bahagi o mana na kasama ng Israel. Kakain sila mula sa mga handog na pagkain para {{divine_name:sa PANGINOONG|kay Yahweh na}}, sapagkat ito ang kanilang mana.
tl.R: Ang mga pari at ang buong lipi ni Levi ay hindi tatanggap ng bahagi sa lupain gaya ng iba pang bahagi ng Israel. Sa halip, mabubuhay sila sa mga handog na pagkaing sinusunog para {{divine_name:sa PANGINOONG|kay Yahweh na}}. Iyon ang kanilang bahagi.

pa.L: ਜਾਜਕਾਂ, ਲੇਵੀਆਂ, ਲੇਵੀ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਗੋਤ ਦਾ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਕੋਈ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਰਾਸਤ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ; ਉਹ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਗ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਈਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਿਰਾਸਤ ਨੂੰ ਖਾਣ।
pa.B: ਲੇਵੀ ਜਾਜਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ, ਸਗੋਂ ਲੇਵੀ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਗੋਤ ਨੂੰ, ਬਾਕੀ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਵਾਂਗ ਕੋਈ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਰਾਸਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲੇਗੀ। ਉਹ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਗ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਈਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਖਾਣਗੇ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਇਹੀ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਿਰਾਸਤ ਹੈ।
pa.R: ਜਾਜਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਅਤੇ ਲੇਵੀ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਗੋਤ ਨੂੰ ਬਾਕੀ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਵਾਂਗ ਜ਼ਮੀਨ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ। ਇਸ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਉਹ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਲਈ ਅੱਗ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਾੜੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਗੁਜ਼ਾਰਾ ਕਰਨਗੇ। ਇਹੀ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਹੈ।

decisions.choice: the priests, the Levites, all the tribe of Levi: the priests who come from Levi, and with them the whole tribe
decisions.reason: "The priests, the Levites" names the priests by their tribe, as in 17:9 and 17:18. "All the tribe of Levi" then widens the rule: neither the priests nor the rest of the tribe receive land. Verses 3-5 go on to the priests' share and verses 6-8 to the other Levites.

decisions.choice: portion and inheritance: a share of the land
decisions.reason: When the land was divided, each tribe received its own territory as a lasting family possession. Levi received none, only towns to live in and what was given to the LORD (10:9; 12:12; 14:27, 29; Numbers 18:20-24; 35:1-8).

decisions.choice: the offerings by fire of the LORD: the gifts presented to the LORD at the altar
decisions.reason: The word is linked to the word for fire and names the offerings given to the LORD on the altar. Parts of many of them were not burned but went to the priests as food (Leviticus 2:3, 10; 6:10-11; Numbers 18:8-19). These gifts are how the priests are to live.

decisions.choice: his inheritance: the inheritance of Levi, that is, what is given to the LORD
alternatives: his inheritance: what belongs to the LORD
decisions.reason: "His" most likely means Levi, the tribe spoken of as one person, as in verse 2 ("the LORD is his inheritance"): the LORD's offerings are what Levi inherits in place of land. It can also be read as the LORD's own inheritance, what belongs to him, which he then shares with the priests. Either way the Levites live on what is given to the LORD.

decisions.choice: the Levitical priests; food offerings
decisions.reason: Balanced says "the Levitical priests" for "the priests, the Levites", as in 17:9; Balanced adds "indeed" to show that the second phrase widens the first. Readable says "the priests" and names the tribe. "Food offerings" is the wording settled in Leviticus for these gifts; Literal keeps "offerings by fire".

decisions.choice: "của lễ dâng bằng lửa" for the fire offerings
decisions.reason: The term sheet's phrase for ʾishsheh, as in Leviticus.

decisions.choice: "sản nghiệp" for the inheritance (L, B); "phần đất", "phần" (R)
decisions.reason: A share of the land handed down in a family (meaning decision); "sản nghiệp" is the word Genesis and Joshua use.

decisions.choice: "불로 바치는 제물" (Literal, Balanced), "불에 태워 바친 제물" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's rendering of the food offering, as Leviticus in this translation.

decisions.choice: as ofertas queimadas (L, B); as ofertas queimadas no fogo (R)
decisions.reason: The term of docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md for this offering (m3), "a oferta queimada", with Readable's "queimadas no fogo" as Leviticus 23:36 has it. "Os sacerdotes, os levitas" (L), "os sacerdotes levitas" (B) as set at 17:9.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The English of this chapter capitalises pronouns for God under the deity_pronoun setting. Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the Amharic has nothing for that setting to change and carries no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: "inheritance" (naḥalah) as "ርስት"; "the offerings by fire" as "በእሳት የሚቀርቡ መሥዋዕቶች"
decisions.reason: Both follow the Pentateuch terms list: "ርስት" for the inheritance, as in Numbers, and "በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት" for the food offering. Readable says "የመሬት ድርሻ" (a share of land) for the portion, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; honorific "उन्होंने", "वे" for God
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi, and the Hindi text has no deity_pronoun spans. Respect for God comes from the honorific third person at every level. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "आग में चढ़ाई गई भेंटें"
decisions.reason: The food offerings (ishsheh) keep the term of Leviticus and the note for the Pentateuch.

decisions.choice: "огненные жертвы"
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note settles "огненная жертва" for ʾishsheh, the gifts presented to the LORD at the altar (m3); this is its first place in Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} надел
decisions.reason: "His inheritance" is the LORD's (m4): what is given to him, which Levi eats. Russian makes the pronoun's owner plain with the span; the English Literal leaves "his" lowercase without one.

decisions.choice: chelek "割り当て地" and nachalah "嗣業" (Literal, Balanced), "土地の分け前" / "受ける分" (Readable); 'ishsheh "火によるささげ物" (L, B), "焼いてささげられる物" (R) as LEV
decisions.reason: "嗣業" is the NUM drafts' word for an inherited share of the land; Readable says what it is.

decisions.choice: "その嗣業" at Literal, leaving open whose inheritance "his" is
decisions.reason: The meaning note marks the referent uncertain; Literal keeps the Hebrew's "his" as "その". Balanced and Readable follow the English reading (what is given to the LORD is their share).

decisions.choice: "korban api-apian" (L, B) for the food offerings by fire
decisions.reason: The offerings burned for the LORD, of which the priests receive a share; Readable explains them.

decisions.choice: 祭司，就是利未人 (L), 利未支派的祭司 (B), 祭司 (R)
decisions.reason: As 17:9: Literal keeps the apposition, Balanced says it in one phrase, Readable names the priests and the tribe.

decisions.choice: "Ang mga pari, ang mga Levita, ang buong lipi ni Levi" (L); "mga paring Levita" (B)
decisions.reason: The priests who come from Levi, and with them the whole tribe (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "bahagi o mana"
decisions.reason: A share of the land (m2).

decisions.choice: "mga handog na pinaraan sa apoy" (L); "mga handog na pagkain" (B); "mga handog na pagkaing sinusunog" (R)
decisions.reason: The gifts presented to the LORD at the altar (m3), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "ang kaniyang mana" (L)
decisions.reason: The inheritance of Levi, that is, what is given to the LORD (m4).

decisions.choice: "ਅੱਗ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਈਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ" (L, B), "ਅੱਗ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਾੜੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 2:3.

source.text: וְנַחֲלָ֥ה לֹא־יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֖וֹ בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֶחָ֑יו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־לֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And inheritance not shall be to him in [the] midst of his brothers; Yahweh, he [is] his inheritance, as he spoke to him.

en.L: And he shall have no inheritance in the midst of his brothers; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is his inheritance, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to him.
en.B: Among the other tribes Levi will own nothing as an inheritance; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is his inheritance, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told him.
en.R: The tribe of Levi will have no land among the other tribes. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} is their share, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised them.

es.L: Y no tendrá herencia en medio de sus hermanos; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es su herencia, como le habló.
es.B: Leví no poseerá nada como herencia entre las demás tribus; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es su herencia, como se lo dijo.
es.R: La tribu de Leví no tendrá tierra entre las otras tribus. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mismo es su parte, tal como se lo prometió.

fr.L: Et il n’aura pas d’héritage au milieu de ses frères ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} son héritage, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le lui a dit.
fr.B: Lévi ne possédera aucun héritage parmi les autres tribus ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est son héritage, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le lui a dit.
fr.R: La tribu de Lévi n’aura pas de terre parmi les autres tribus. C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} qui est leur part, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le leur a promis.

sw.L: Wala hatakuwa na urithi katikati ya ndugu zake; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye urithi wake, kama alivyomwambia.
sw.B: Lawi hatamiliki kitu chochote kama urithi miongoni mwa makabila mengine; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye urithi wake, kama alivyomwambia.
sw.R: Kabila la Lawi halitakuwa na ardhi miongoni mwa makabila mengine. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} ndiye fungu lao, kama alivyowaahidi.

vi.L: Và người ấy sẽ không có sản nghiệp ở giữa anh em mình; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là sản nghiệp của người ấy, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với người ấy.
vi.B: Lê-vi sẽ không có sản nghiệp giữa các chi tộc anh em; chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là sản nghiệp của Lê-vi, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với họ.
vi.R: Chi tộc Lê-vi sẽ không có đất đai giữa các chi tộc khác. Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là phần của họ, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그에게는 그의 형제들 가운데서 유산이 없을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하신 대로, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분이 그의 유산이시다.
ko.B: 레위는 다른 지파들 가운데서 유산으로 받을 것이 없다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하신 대로, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 그의 유산이시다.
ko.R: 레위 지파는 다른 지파들 가운데서 땅을 받지 못합니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 약속하신 대로, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 그들의 몫이 되어 주십니다.

pt.L: E herança não terá ele no meio dos seus irmãos; {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] a sua herança, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe falou.
pt.B: Levi não terá herança entre as outras tribos; {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é a sua herança, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe disse.
pt.R: A tribo de Levi não vai ter terra entre as outras tribos. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} {{deity_pronoun:mesmo|Mesmo}} é a parte deles, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} prometeu.

am.L: በወንድሞቹም መካከል ርስት አይኖረውም፤ እንደ ነገረው፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እርሱ ርስቱ ነው።
am.B: ሌዊ ከሌሎቹ ነገዶች መካከል ርስት አድርጎ የሚይዘው ምንም ነገር የለውም፤ እንደ ነገረው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ርስቱ ነው።
am.R: የሌዊ ነገድ ከሌሎቹ ነገዶች መካከል መሬት አይኖረውም። ተስፋ እንደ ሰጣቸው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ራሱ ድርሻቸው ነው።

hi.L: और अपने भाइयों के बीच उसका कोई निज भाग न होगा; {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, वे ही उसका निज भाग [हैं], जैसा उन्होंने उससे कहा।
hi.B: दूसरे गोत्रों के बीच लेवी का कोई निज भाग न होगा; {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही उसका निज भाग हैं, जैसा उन्होंने उससे कहा था।
hi.R: लेवी के गोत्र को दूसरे गोत्रों के बीच कोई ज़मीन नहीं मिलेगी। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} स्वयं उनका हिस्सा हैं, जैसा उन्होंने उनसे वादा किया था।

ru.L: И надела не будет у него среди его братьев: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} его надел, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорил ему.
ru.B: Среди других колен у Левия не будет никакого удела: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — его удел, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ему сказал.
ru.R: У племени Левия не будет земли среди других племён. Сам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — их доля, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} и обещал им.

ja.L: そして彼には、彼の兄弟たちのただ中に嗣業はない。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、その方が彼の嗣業である。かつて彼に語られたとおりである。
ja.B: レビは、ほかの部族の中で嗣業を持たない。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼の嗣業である。かつて彼に告げられたとおりである。
ja.R: レビの部族は、ほかの部族の中で自分の土地を持たない。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}ご自身が、彼らの受ける分である。それは、彼らに約束されたとおりである。

uk.L: І не буде йому спадщини серед його братів; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} його спадщина, як {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} говорив йому.
uk.B: Серед інших племен Левій нічого не матиме у спадщину; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — його спадщина, як {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сказав йому.
uk.R: Племʼя Левія не матиме землі серед інших племен. Сам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — їхня частка, як {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і обіцяв їм.

id.L: Dan milik pusaka tidak akan ada padanya di tengah-tengah saudara-saudaranya; {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}}lah milik pusakanya, seperti yang difirmankan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} kepadanya.
id.B: Di antara suku-suku saudaranya, Lewi tidak akan memiliki milik pusaka; {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} sendirilah milik pusakanya, seperti yang difirmankan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} kepadanya.
id.R: Suku Lewi tidak akan mempunyai tanah di antara suku-suku lain. {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} sendirilah bagian mereka, sama seperti yang dijanjikan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} kepada mereka.

zh.L: 他在他弟兄中间不可有产业；{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}就是他的产业，正如{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}对他所说的。
zh.B: 利未在其他支派中间不会拥有产业；{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}就是他的产业，正如{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}告诉过他的。
zh.R: 利未支派不会在其他支派中间分到土地。{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}自己就是他们的份，正如{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}应许过他们的。

tl.L: At hindi siya magkakaroon ng mana sa gitna ng kaniyang mga kapatid; {{divine_name:ang PANGINOON|si Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:siya|Siya}} ang kaniyang mana, gaya ng sinabi {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} sa kaniya.
tl.B: Walang aariing mana si Levi sa gitna ng ibang mga lipi; {{divine_name:ang PANGINOON|si Yahweh}} ang kaniyang mana, gaya ng sinabi {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} sa kaniya.
tl.R: Hindi magkakaroon ng lupain ang lipi ni Levi sa gitna ng ibang mga lipi. {{divine_name:Ang PANGINOON|Si Yahweh}} mismo ang kanilang bahagi, gaya ng ipinangako {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} sa kanila.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਭਰਾਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਾਸਤ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ; {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}}, ਉਹ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਵਿਰਾਸਤ ਹਨ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਆਖਿਆ ਸੀ।
pa.B: ਦੂਜੇ ਗੋਤਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੇਵੀ ਦੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਾਸਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ; {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਵਿਰਾਸਤ ਹਨ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਗੱਲ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੀ।
pa.R: ਲੇਵੀ ਦੇ ਗੋਤ ਕੋਲ ਬਾਕੀ ਗੋਤਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਕੋਈ ਜ਼ਮੀਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ। {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪ ਹੀ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਹਨ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਵਾਇਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੀ।

decisions.choice: him; his brothers: the tribe of Levi, and the other tribes of Israel
decisions.reason: As in verse 1 and 10:9, the tribe is spoken of as one man, Levi. "His brothers" are the other tribes, all descended from the sons of Jacob.

decisions.choice: the LORD, he is his inheritance: Levi's portion is the LORD himself
decisions.reason: The pronoun "he" is written out for emphasis. In place of fields and pasture, Levi has the LORD, his service and what is given to him. Psalms 16:5 and 73:26 use the same picture for the believer who has God as his portion.

decisions.choice: as he spoke to him: the LORD's word to Aaron in Numbers 18:20
decisions.reason: In Numbers 18:20 the LORD tells Aaron, "I am your portion and your inheritance among the sons of Israel." Deuteronomy 10:9 refers to the same promise.

decisions.choice: Levi; the other tribes; the tribe of Levi ... their
decisions.reason: Balanced names Levi and says "the other tribes" for "his brothers". Readable says "the tribe of Levi" and uses "their", as in 10:9, so that no one thinks of a single man; it says "promised", the sense of "spoke" here.

decisions.choice: The English deity_pronoun spans become "その方" (Literal), a repeated name or nothing (Balanced, Readable), with no span
decisions.reason: Japanese has no deity_pronoun spans and does not use 彼 for God. Balanced and Readable leave the subject of the last clause unspoken.

decisions.choice: "siya ... kaniyang mga kapatid" (L); "si Levi ... ibang mga lipi" (B); "ang lipi ni Levi ... kanila" (R)
decisions.reason: The tribe of Levi, and the other tribes of Israel (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "ang PANGINOON ... ang kaniyang mana"
decisions.reason: Levi's portion is the LORD himself (m2).

decisions.choice: "gaya ng sinabi niya sa kaniya"
decisions.reason: The LORD's word to Aaron in Numbers 18:20 (m3).

source.text: וְזֶ֡ה יִהְיֶה֩ מִשְׁפַּ֨ט הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים מֵאֵ֣ת הָעָ֗ם מֵאֵ֛ת זֹבְחֵ֥י הַזֶּ֖בַח אִם־שׁ֣וֹר אִם־שֶׂ֑ה וְנָתַן֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן הַזְּרֹ֥עַ וְהַלְּחָיַ֖יִם וְהַקֵּבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And this shall be [the] due of the priests from the people, from those sacrificing the sacrifice, whether ox or sheep: and he shall give to the priest the shoulder and the two cheeks and the stomach.

en.L: And this shall be the priests' due from the people, from those who sacrifice a sacrifice, whether ox or sheep: he shall give to the priest the shoulder and the two cheeks and the stomach.
en.B: This is what the priests are owed by the people who offer a sacrifice, whether an ox or a sheep: they are to give the priest the shoulder, the jaws and the stomach.
en.R: When people offer a sacrifice of a bull or cow, or of a sheep or goat, they must give the priest his share. He gets the shoulder, the cheeks and the stomach.

es.L: Y este será el derecho de los sacerdotes de parte del pueblo, de parte de los que ofrecen un sacrificio, sea buey o sea oveja: dará al sacerdote la espaldilla, las dos mejillas y el estómago.
es.B: Esto es lo que los sacerdotes tienen derecho a recibir del pueblo, de los que ofrecen un sacrificio, sea buey u oveja: darán al sacerdote la espaldilla, las quijadas y el estómago.
es.R: Cuando alguien ofrezca en sacrificio un toro o una vaca, o una oveja o una cabra, tiene que darle al sacerdote su parte. Al sacerdote le tocan la espaldilla, las mejillas y el estómago.

fr.L: Et voici ce que sera le dû des prêtres de la part du peuple, de la part de ceux qui offrent un sacrifice, que ce soit un bœuf ou un mouton : il donnera au prêtre l’épaule, les deux joues et l’estomac.
fr.B: Voici ce que les prêtres sont en droit de recevoir du peuple, de ceux qui offrent un sacrifice, bœuf ou mouton : ils donneront au prêtre l’épaule, les mâchoires et l’estomac.
fr.R: Quand des gens offrent en sacrifice un taureau ou une vache, un mouton ou une chèvre, ils doivent donner au prêtre sa part. Il reçoit l’épaule, les joues et l’estomac.

sw.L: Na hii ndiyo itakayokuwa stahili ya makuhani kutoka kwa watu, kutoka kwa wale wanaotoa dhabihu, ikiwa ni ng'ombe au kondoo: atampa kuhani bega, na mashavu mawili, na tumbo.
sw.B: Hiki ndicho makuhani wanachostahili kupokea kutoka kwa watu wanaotoa dhabihu, iwe ng'ombe au kondoo: watampa kuhani bega, taya na tumbo.
sw.R: Watu wanapotoa dhabihu ya fahali au ng'ombe jike, au ya kondoo au mbuzi, lazima wampe kuhani fungu lake. Yeye anapata bega, mashavu na tumbo.

vi.L: Và đây sẽ là phần thuộc về các thầy tế lễ từ dân chúng, từ những người dâng sinh tế, dù là bò hay chiên: người ấy phải đưa cho thầy tế lễ cái vai, hai cái má và cái dạ dày.
vi.B: Đây là phần dân chúng phải trả cho các thầy tế lễ khi dâng sinh tế, dù là bò hay chiên: họ phải đưa cho thầy tế lễ cái vai, hai má và cái dạ dày.
vi.R: Khi người ta dâng một con bò, một con chiên hay một con dê làm sinh tế, họ phải đưa cho thầy tế lễ phần của ông. Thầy tế lễ được cái vai, hai má và cái dạ dày.

ko.L: 그리고 백성에게서, 곧 제물을 잡아 바치는 자들에게서 제사장들이 받을 몫은 이러하다. 소든 양이든 [바치는 사람은] 앞다리와 두 볼과 위를 제사장에게 주어야 한다.
ko.B: 백성이 소나 양을 잡아 제물로 바칠 때 제사장들이 받을 몫은 이러하다. 그들은 앞다리와 턱과 위를 제사장에게 주어야 한다.
ko.R: 사람들이 소나 양이나 염소를 제물로 잡아 바칠 때에는 제사장에게 그의 몫을 주어야 합니다. 제사장은 앞다리와 볼살과 위를 받습니다.

pt.L: E este será o direito dos sacerdotes da parte do povo, da parte dos que sacrificam um sacrifício, seja boi, seja ovelha: ele dará ao sacerdote a espádua, e as duas queixadas, e o estômago.
pt.B: Isto é o que os sacerdotes têm o direito de receber do povo que oferece um sacrifício, seja um boi, seja uma ovelha: dará ao sacerdote a espádua, as queixadas e o estômago.
pt.R: Quando as pessoas oferecerem um sacrifício de um boi ou de uma vaca, ou de uma ovelha ou de uma cabra, devem dar ao sacerdote a parte dele. Ele recebe a paleta, as bochechas e o estômago.

am.L: ከሕዝቡ፣ በሬም ቢሆን በግ፣ መሥዋዕትን ከሚሠዉት የካህናቱ ድርሻ ይህ ይሆናል፤ ለካህኑ ወርቹን፣ ሁለቱን መንጋጋዎችና ጨጓራውን ይሰጣል።
am.B: መሥዋዕት ከሚያቀርቡ ሰዎች፣ በሬም ይሁን በግ፣ ካህናቱ የሚገባቸው ድርሻ ይህ ነው፤ ለካህኑ ወርቹን፣ መንጋጋዎቹንና ጨጓራውን ይስጡ።
am.R: ሰዎች በሬ ወይም ላም፣ በግ ወይም ፍየል መሥዋዕት አድርገው ሲያቀርቡ ለካህኑ ድርሻውን መስጠት አለባቸው። እርሱም ወርቹን፣ መንጋጋዎቹንና ጨጓራውን ያገኛል።

hi.L: और लोगों की ओर से, बलिदान का बलिदान करनेवालों की ओर से, याजकों का हक़ यह होगा, चाहे बैल हो या भेड़: वह याजक को कंधा और दोनों गाल और पेट दे।
hi.B: जो लोग बलिदान चढ़ाते हैं, चाहे बैल हो या भेड़, उनसे याजकों का यह हक़ है: वे याजक को कंधा, जबड़े और पेट दें।
hi.R: जब लोग गाय-बैल या भेड़-बकरी का बलिदान करें, तो वे याजक को उसका हिस्सा दें। उसे कंधा, गाल और पेट मिलें।

ru.L: И вот что положено священникам от народа, от приносящих жертву, вола ли или ягнёнка: пусть отдаёт священнику лопатку, и обе челюсти, и желудок.
ru.B: Вот что причитается священникам от людей, которые приносят жертву, быка или овцу: они должны отдавать священнику лопатку, челюсти и желудок.
ru.R: Когда люди приносят в жертву быка или корову, овцу или козу, они должны отдать священнику его долю. Он получает лопатку, щёки и желудок.

ja.L: そして、民から、すなわち、牛であれ羊であれ、いけにえをささげる者たちから受ける祭司たちの取り分はこうである。彼は祭司に、肩と両あごと胃を与えなければならない。
ja.B: 民がいけにえをささげるとき、牛であれ羊であれ、祭司が受ける当然の取り分はこうである。祭司に肩と両あごと胃を与えなさい。
ja.R: 人々が牛や羊、やぎをいけにえとしてささげるときは、祭司にその取り分を渡さなければならない。祭司が受け取るのは、肩と両方のほおと胃である。

uk.L: І ось що буде належне священникам від народу, від тих, хто приносить жертву, чи вола, чи вівцю: нехай дає священникові лопатку, і обидві щелепи, і шлунок.
uk.B: Ось що священники мають отримувати від людей, які приносять жертву, чи вола, чи вівцю: вони мають давати священникові лопатку, щелепи й шлунок.
uk.R: Коли люди приносять у жертву бика чи корову, вівцю чи козу, вони мусять дати священникові його частку. Він отримує лопатку, щоки й шлунок.

id.L: Dan inilah hak para imam dari bangsa itu, dari orang-orang yang mempersembahkan korban sembelihan, baik lembu maupun domba: ia harus memberikan kepada imam paha depan dan kedua rahang dan perut besar.
id.B: Inilah yang menjadi hak para imam dari rakyat yang mempersembahkan korban, baik lembu maupun domba: mereka harus memberikan kepada imam paha depan, kedua rahang, dan perut besar.
id.R: Apabila orang mempersembahkan korban lembu, atau domba, atau kambing, mereka harus memberikan bagian imam. Imam mendapat paha depan, pipi, dan perut binatang itu.

zh.L: 祭司从百姓、从献祭的人所当得的，是这样：无论[献的是]牛或羊，都要把前腿、两腮和胃给祭司。
zh.B: 百姓献祭的时候，无论献的是牛还是羊，祭司应得的份是这样：要把前腿、腮肉和胃给祭司。
zh.R: 百姓献上公牛或母牛、绵羊或山羊作祭物的时候，必须把祭司的份给他。他可以得到前腿、腮肉和胃。

tl.L: At ito ang magiging karapatan ng mga pari mula sa bayan, mula sa mga naghahain ng hain, baka man o tupa: ibibigay niya sa pari ang balikat at ang dalawang pisngi at ang sikmura.
tl.B: Ito ang nararapat sa mga pari mula sa mga taong naghahandog ng hain, baka man o tupa: dapat nilang ibigay sa pari ang balikat, ang mga panga at ang sikmura.
tl.R: Kapag naghandog ang mga tao ng hain na baka, o ng tupa o kambing, dapat nilang ibigay sa pari ang kaniyang bahagi. Mapupunta sa kaniya ang balikat, ang mga pisngi at ang sikmura.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਵੱਲੋਂ, ਬਲੀ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਵੱਲੋਂ, ਭਾਵੇਂ ਬਲਦ ਹੋਵੇ ਜਾਂ ਭੇਡ, ਜਾਜਕਾਂ ਦਾ ਇਹ ਹੱਕ ਹੋਵੇ: ਉਹ ਜਾਜਕ ਨੂੰ ਮੋਢਾ ਅਤੇ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਜਬਾੜੇ ਅਤੇ ਓਝਰੀ ਦੇਵੇ।
pa.B: ਜਿਹੜੇ ਲੋਕ ਬਲੀ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਭਾਵੇਂ ਬਲਦ ਦੀ ਭਾਵੇਂ ਭੇਡ ਦੀ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਜਾਜਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਮਿਲਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ: ਉਹ ਜਾਜਕ ਨੂੰ ਮੋਢਾ, ਜਬਾੜੇ ਅਤੇ ਓਝਰੀ ਦੇਣ।
pa.R: ਜਦ ਲੋਕ ਗਾਂ-ਬਲਦ ਜਾਂ ਭੇਡ-ਬੱਕਰੀ ਦੀ ਬਲੀ ਦੇਣ, ਤਾਂ ਉਹ ਜਾਜਕ ਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਦੇਣ। ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਮੋਢਾ, ਜਬਾੜੇ ਅਤੇ ਓਝਰੀ ਮਿਲਣ।

decisions.choice: the due of the priests: the share that is theirs by right
decisions.reason: The word usually means judgment or ruling, but here it is what is rightly owed, the priests' fixed claim. In 1 Samuel 2:13 the same word describes the priests' practice at Shiloh, where Eli's sons took more than was theirs.

decisions.choice: those who sacrifice a sacrifice: worshipers who slaughter an animal for a shared meal
decisions.reason: This kind of sacrifice was eaten by the worshipers at the chosen place, with a part for the altar and a part for the priest (12:6-7, 27). The list of parts here is not the same as the breast and right thigh given to the priests in Leviticus 7:31-34; the text does not say how the two lists relate.

decisions.choice: ox or sheep: an animal from the herd or the flock
decisions.reason: The first word is any head of cattle, bull or cow. The second is a single animal of the flock, sheep or goat (14:4).

decisions.choice: the shoulder, the two cheeks, the stomach: the foreleg, the jaws with their meat, and the stomach
decisions.reason: The first word is the arm, here the upper foreleg of the animal. The second is the jawbones and cheeks. The third is the stomach, the part that digests the food. All three were parts that could be eaten.

decisions.choice: he shall give: each worshiper gives
decisions.reason: The verb is singular: each person who brings the sacrifice gives the priest these parts.

decisions.choice: an ox or a sheep; a bull or cow, a sheep or goat; the jaws / the cheeks
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "ox" and "sheep". Readable names both kinds each word can mean. Balanced says "jaws" and Readable "cheeks" for the jawbones with their meat; Literal keeps "the two cheeks". Balanced says "they" for the singular "he", since every worshiper is meant.

decisions.choice: "stahili ya makuhani" (L); "wanachostahili kupokea" (B)
decisions.reason: The word here is what the priests are rightly owed. Swahili says this with "stahili" (what one is entitled to), and keeps "haki" for righteousness and justice.

decisions.choice: "앞다리", "두 볼" (Literal) / "턱" (Balanced) / "볼살" (Readable), "위"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the "arm" as the foreleg; the Balanced follows the English "jaws", the Readable says the meat of the cheeks.

decisions.choice: a espádua, as (duas) queixadas, o estômago (L, B); a paleta, as bochechas, o estômago (R)
decisions.reason: The parts of the animal (m4) take the words of the butcher's and the cook's Portuguese: "espádua" for the foreleg and shoulder, "queixadas" for the jaws with their meat; Readable says "paleta", the cut Brazilian readers know, and "bochechas", as the English Readable says "cheeks".

decisions.choice: "the shoulder, the two cheeks, the stomach" as "ወርች", "መንጋጋዎች", "ጨጓራ"
decisions.reason: "ወርች" is the foreleg and shoulder of a slaughtered animal, "መንጋጋ" the jaw with its meat, and "ጨጓራ" the stomach itself, rather than "ሆድ ዕቃ", which means the inner parts in general.

decisions.choice: mishpat (the priests' due) "取り分" (every level; Balanced "当然の取り分")
decisions.reason: Here mishpat is the share that belongs to the priests by right, not a ruling.

decisions.choice: 前腿; 两腮 (L), 腮肉 (B, R); 胃
decisions.reason: The parts named (m4): the foreleg "前腿", the jaws with their meat "两腮" at Literal and "腮肉" at Balanced and Readable, and the stomach "胃".

decisions.choice: "karapatan ng mga pari" (L); "nararapat sa mga pari" (B); "ang kaniyang bahagi" (R)
decisions.reason: The share that is theirs by right (m1).

decisions.choice: "mga naghahain ng hain"
decisions.reason: Worshipers who slaughter an animal for a shared meal (m2).

decisions.choice: "baka man o tupa"; "baka, o ng tupa o kambing" (R)
decisions.reason: An animal from the herd or the flock (m3), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "balikat ... dalawang pisngi ... sikmura"; "mga panga" (B)
decisions.reason: The foreleg, the jaws with their meat, and the stomach (m4), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "ibibigay niya" (L)
decisions.reason: Each worshiper gives (m5).

source.text: רֵאשִׁ֨ית דְּגָֽנְךָ֜ תִּֽירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֗ךָ וְרֵאשִׁ֛ית גֵּ֥ז צֹאנְךָ֖ תִּתֶּן־לּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] first of your grain, your new wine and your fresh oil, and [the] first of [the] fleece of your flock you shall give to him.

en.L: The first of your grain, your new wine and your fresh oil, and the first of the shearing of your flock you shall give to him.
en.B: Give him as well the first of your grain, of your new wine and of your olive oil, and the first wool your sheep yield at shearing.
en.R: Also give the priest the first part of your grain, your new wine and your olive oil. And give him the first wool you cut from your sheep.

es.L: Las primicias de tu grano, de tu vino nuevo y de tu aceite fresco, y las primicias del esquileo de tu rebaño, se las darás.
es.B: Dale también las primicias de tu grano, de tu vino nuevo y de tu aceite de oliva, y la primera lana que den tus ovejas al esquilarlas.
es.R: Dale también al sacerdote la primera parte de tu grano, de tu vino nuevo y de tu aceite de oliva. Y dale la primera lana que cortes de tus ovejas.

fr.L: Les prémices de ton blé, de ton vin nouveau et de ton huile fraîche, et les prémices de la tonte de ton petit bétail, tu les lui donneras.
fr.B: Donne-lui aussi les prémices de ton grain, de ton vin nouveau et de ton huile d’olive, ainsi que la première laine que donnent tes moutons à la tonte.
fr.R: Donne aussi au prêtre la première part de ton grain, de ton vin nouveau et de ton huile d’olive. Et donne-lui la première laine que tu coupes sur tes moutons.

sw.L: Malimbuko ya nafaka yako, ya divai yako mpya na ya mafuta yako mabichi, na malimbuko ya manyoya ya kondoo wako yanayokatwa, utampa.
sw.B: Mpe pia malimbuko ya nafaka yako, ya divai yako mpya na ya mafuta yako ya zeituni, na sufu ya kwanza unayoikata kutoka kwa kondoo wako.
sw.R: Pia mpe kuhani sehemu ya kwanza ya nafaka yako, ya divai yako mpya na ya mafuta yako ya zeituni. Tena mpe sufu ya kwanza unayoikata kutoka kwa kondoo wako.

vi.L: Hoa quả đầu mùa của ngũ cốc ngươi, rượu mới và dầu mới của ngươi, và lông đầu mùa khi xén lông bầy chiên ngươi, ngươi phải đưa cho người ấy.
vi.B: Anh em cũng phải đưa cho thầy tế lễ hoa quả đầu mùa của ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu của anh em, cùng với mớ lông đầu tiên khi xén lông chiên.
vi.R: Cũng hãy đưa cho thầy tế lễ phần đầu tiên của ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu của anh em. Hãy đưa cho ông mớ lông đầu tiên anh em xén từ đàn chiên của mình.

ko.L: 네 곡식과 네 새 포도주와 네 새 기름의 첫 [소산]과 네 양 떼의 털을 깎은 것의 첫 [것]을 너는 그에게 주어라.
ko.B: 너희가 거둔 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름의 첫 소산을 제사장에게 주고, 양털을 깎을 때 처음 깎은 털도 그에게 주어라.
ko.R: 또 여러분이 거둔 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름 가운데서 처음 것을 제사장에게 주십시오. 양털을 깎을 때에도 처음 깎은 털을 그에게 주십시오.

pt.L: As primícias do teu cereal, do teu vinho novo e do teu azeite fresco, e as primícias da tosquia do teu rebanho lhe darás.
pt.B: Darás a ele também as primícias do teu cereal, do teu vinho novo e do teu azeite, e a primeira lã que as tuas ovelhas derem na tosquia.
pt.R: Dá também ao sacerdote a primeira parte do teu cereal, do teu vinho novo e do teu azeite. E dá a ele a primeira lã que cortares das tuas ovelhas.

am.L: የእህልህን፣ የአዲሱን የወይን ጠጅህንና የአዲሱን ዘይትህን መጀመሪያ፣ ከመንጋህም የምትሸልተውን የመጀመሪያ ጠጉር ትሰጠዋለህ።
am.B: እንዲሁም የእህልህን፣ የአዲሱን የወይን ጠጅህንና የወይራ ዘይትህን በኩራት፣ በጎችህን ስትሸልትም የመጀመሪያውን ሱፍ ስጠው።
am.R: ደግሞም ከእህልህ፣ ከአዲሱ የወይን ጠጅህና ከወይራ ዘይትህ የመጀመሪያውን ክፍል ለካህኑ ስጥ። ከበጎችህ የምትሸልተውንም የመጀመሪያ ሱፍ ስጠው።

hi.L: अपने अनाज, अपने नए दाखमधु और अपने ताज़ा तेल की पहली उपज, और अपनी भेड़ों के ऊन की पहली कतरन तुम उसे देना।
hi.B: उसे अपने अनाज, अपने नए दाखमधु और अपने जैतून के तेल की पहली उपज भी देना, और अपनी भेड़ों से कतरा गया पहला ऊन भी।
hi.R: याजक को अपने अनाज, नए दाखमधु और जैतून के तेल का पहला भाग भी देना। और अपनी भेड़ों से उतारा गया पहला ऊन भी उसे देना।

ru.L: Начатки твоего зерна, твоего молодого вина и твоего масла и начатки стрижки твоих овец отдавай ему.
ru.B: Отдавай ему также первое от своего зерна, молодого вина и оливкового масла и первую шерсть со стрижки своих овец.
ru.R: Ещё отдавай священнику первую часть своего зерна, молодого вина и оливкового масла. И отдавай ему первую шерсть, которую ты состриг со своих овец.

ja.L: あなたの穀物、あなたの新しいぶどう酒、あなたの新しい油の初物と、あなたの羊の毛の刈り取りの初物を、あなたは彼に与えなければならない。
ja.B: また、あなたの穀物と新しいぶどう酒とオリーブ油の初物、また羊の毛を刈ったときの最初の毛を、祭司に与えなさい。
ja.R: また、あなたの穀物と新しいぶどう酒とオリーブ油の最初の分を、祭司にあげなさい。羊から最初に刈った毛も、祭司にあげなさい。

uk.L: Первоплоди твого зерна, твого молодого вина і твоєї свіжої олії, і першу стриж твоєї отари дай йому.
uk.B: Давай йому також первоплоди свого зерна, свого молодого вина і своєї оливкової олії, а також першу вовну, яку дадуть твої вівці при стрижці.
uk.R: Давай священникові також першу частину свого зерна, молодого вина й оливкової олії. І давай йому першу вовну, яку ти острижеш зі своїх овець.

id.L: Hasil pertama gandummu, anggurmu yang baru dan minyakmu, dan hasil pertama guntingan bulu dombamu haruslah kauberikan kepadanya.
id.B: Berikanlah juga kepadanya hasil pertama dari gandummu, anggurmu yang baru, dan minyak zaitunmu, serta bulu domba yang pertama kali kaugunting.
id.R: Berikanlah juga kepada imam bagian pertama dari gandum, anggur yang baru, dan minyak zaitun kalian. Berikanlah kepadanya bulu domba pertama yang kalian gunting dari domba kalian.

zh.L: 你初收的五谷、新酒和新油，以及你羊群初剪的毛，你都要给他。
zh.B: 你也要把初收的五谷、新酒和橄榄油，以及你的羊初次剪下的毛，都给他。
zh.R: 还要把你最先收的粮食、新酒和橄榄油给祭司，也要把你最先从羊身上剪下的毛给他。

tl.L: Ang unang bunga ng iyong butil, ng iyong bagong alak at ng iyong langis, at ang unang gupit ng balahibo ng iyong kawan ay ibibigay mo sa kaniya.
tl.B: Ibigay rin ninyo sa kaniya ang unang bahagi ng inyong butil, ng inyong bagong alak at ng inyong langis ng olibo, at ang unang balahibong nagugupit sa inyong mga tupa.
tl.R: Ibigay rin ninyo sa pari ang unang bahagi ng inyong butil, ng inyong bagong alak at ng inyong langis ng olibo. At ibigay ninyo sa kaniya ang unang balahibong nagugupit ninyo sa inyong mga tupa.

pa.L: ਆਪਣੇ ਅਨਾਜ, ਆਪਣੀ ਨਵੀਂ ਮੈਅ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਤਾਜ਼ੇ ਤੇਲ ਦਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਫਲ, ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਇੱਜੜ ਦੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਕਤਰੀ ਉੱਨ ਤੂੰ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਦੇਈਂ।
pa.B: ਆਪਣੇ ਅਨਾਜ, ਨਵੀਂ ਮੈਅ ਅਤੇ ਜ਼ੈਤੂਨ ਦੇ ਤੇਲ ਦਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਦੇਈਂ, ਅਤੇ ਭੇਡਾਂ ਦੀ ਕਤਰਾਈ ਵੇਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਉੱਨ ਵੀ।
pa.R: ਜਾਜਕ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਅਨਾਜ, ਨਵੀਂ ਮੈਅ ਅਤੇ ਜ਼ੈਤੂਨ ਦੇ ਤੇਲ ਦਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਵੀ ਦੇਈਂ। ਅਤੇ ਜਿਹੜੀ ਉੱਨ ਤੂੰ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਭੇਡਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਲਾਹੇਂ, ਉਹ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਦੇਈਂ।

decisions.choice: the first: the firstfruits, the first and best of each year's harvest
decisions.reason: The first part of the harvest belonged to the LORD and was given to the priests (Exodus 23:19; Numbers 18:12-13; 26:2). The first of the wool is not named in Numbers 18; Deuteronomy adds it.

decisions.choice: new wine and fresh oil: the new juice of the grapes and the new oil of the olives
decisions.reason: The two words name the fresh produce of the vineyard and the olive grove, here as in 7:13 and 14:23. With grain they are the three main crops of the land.

decisions.choice: to him: to the priest
decisions.reason: "Him" is the priest of verse 3, the one serving at the chosen place.

decisions.choice: olive oil; the first wool your sheep yield at shearing
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "olive oil", the kind meant, and say what the "first of the shearing of your flock" is. Readable says "the priest" for "him".

decisions.choice: "tú" for Israel addressed in the singular ("tu Dios", "te"), with the plural_you span only where the Hebrew turns to the plural (verse 15, "you shall listen")
decisions.reason: Moses addresses Israel as one person through the chapter, as the Hebrew singular forms show; the one plural verb in verse 15 speaks to all the people.

decisions.choice: "tu" for Israel addressed in the singular, "vous" where the Hebrew turns to the plural (verse 15)
decisions.reason: French follows the Hebrew number of "you", as in the rest of Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: singular forms ("wako", "utampa") for Israel addressed as one, plural ("mtamsikiliza") where the Hebrew turns to the plural (verse 15)
decisions.reason: Swahili follows the Hebrew number of "you", as in the rest of Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "hoa quả đầu mùa" (L, B); "phần đầu tiên" (R)
decisions.reason: The firstfruits (meaning decision), as Exodus 23:16-19 names them.

decisions.choice: "unang bunga" (L); "unang bahagi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The firstfruits, the first and best of each year's harvest (m1).

decisions.choice: "bagong alak ... langis"; "langis ng olibo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The new juice of the grapes and the new oil of the olives (m2), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "sa kaniya"; "sa pari" (R)
decisions.reason: To the priest (m3).

decisions.choice: "mo" (L); "ninyo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal follows the singular of the Hebrew; Balanced and Readable address the assembly as many, as recorded at 1:21 (m3).

source.text: כִּ֣י ב֗וֹ בָּחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִכָּל־שְׁבָטֶ֑יךָ לַעֲמֹ֨ד לְשָׁרֵ֧ת בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָ֛ה ה֥וּא וּבָנָ֖יו כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For him has chosen Yahweh your God from all your tribes, to stand to minister in [the] name of Yahweh, he and his sons, all the days.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has chosen him out of all your tribes, to stand to minister in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, him and his sons, all the days.
en.B: Out of all your tribes it is he whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has chosen, he and his sons, to stand and serve in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for all time.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God chose the priests and their descendants from all your tribes. They are to stand before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and serve in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name for all time.

es.L: Porque a él lo ha escogido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios de entre todas tus tribus, para estar en pie y ministrar en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, él y sus hijos, todos los días.
es.B: De todas tus tribus, es a él a quien {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios ha escogido, a él y a sus hijos, para estar de pie y servir en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para siempre.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios escogió a los sacerdotes y a sus descendientes de entre todas tus tribus. Ellos deben estar delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y servir en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre para siempre.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu l’a choisi parmi toutes tes tribus, pour se tenir [là] et servir au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, lui et ses fils, tous les jours.
fr.B: De toutes tes tribus, c’est lui que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu a choisi, lui et ses fils, pour se tenir là et servir au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour toujours.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu a choisi les prêtres et leurs descendants parmi toutes tes tribus. Ils doivent se tenir devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et servir en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom pour toujours.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amemchagua yeye kutoka katika makabila yako yote, ili asimame kuhudumu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yeye na wanawe, siku zote.
sw.B: Katika makabila yako yote, yeye ndiye ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amemchagua, yeye na wanawe, ili wasimame na kuhudumu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} daima.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako aliwachagua makuhani na wazao wao kutoka katika makabila yako yote. Wanapaswa kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kuhudumu kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} daima.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã chọn người ấy từ trong mọi chi tộc của ngươi, để đứng phục vụ trong danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, người ấy và các con trai người, mọi ngày.
vi.B: Vì trong mọi chi tộc của anh em, chính người ấy được {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em chọn, người ấy và các con trai mình, để đứng phục vụ trong danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mãi mãi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đã chọn các thầy tế lễ và con cháu họ từ trong mọi chi tộc của anh em. Họ phải đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và phục vụ nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mãi mãi.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님께서 네 모든 지파 가운데서 그를 택하셔서, 그와 그의 아들들이 언제나 서서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 섬기게 하셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께서 너희 모든 지파 가운데서 바로 그를 택하셔서, 그와 그의 자손이 언제까지나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 서서 섬기게 하셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께서 여러분의 모든 지파 가운데서 제사장들과 그 자손을 택하셨습니다. 그들은 언제까지나 그분 앞에 서서 그분의 이름으로 섬길 것입니다.

pt.L: Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, o escolheu dentre todas as tuas tribos, para estar de pé servindo em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, ele e os seus filhos, todos os dias.
pt.B: Pois foi a ele que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, escolheu dentre todas as tuas tribos, a ele e aos seus filhos, para estar ali e servir em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para sempre.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, escolheu os sacerdotes e os seus descendentes dentre todas as tuas tribos. Eles devem ficar diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} e servir em {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome para sempre.

am.L: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም ቆመው ያገለግሉ ዘንድ እርሱንና ልጆቹን በዘመኑ ሁሉ ከነገዶችህ ሁሉ መርጧልና።
am.B: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እርሱና ልጆቹ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም ለዘላለም ቆመው እንዲያገለግሉ ከነገዶችህ ሁሉ የመረጠው እርሱን ነውና።
am.R: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ካህናቱንና ዘሮቻቸውን ከነገዶችህ ሁሉ መርጧቸዋል። በፊቱ ቆመው በስሙ ለዘላለም ያገለግላሉ።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हारे सब गोत्रों में से उसी को चुना है, कि वह और उसके पुत्र सब दिन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से सेवा करने के लिए खड़े रहें।
hi.B: तुम्हारे सब गोत्रों में से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने उसी को, उसे और उसके पुत्रों को, चुना है कि वे सदा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से खड़े होकर सेवा करें।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हारे सब गोत्रों में से याजकों और उनके वंशजों को चुना। वे सदा उनके सामने खड़े होकर उनके नाम से सेवा करें।

ru.L: Потому что его избрал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, из всех твоих колен, чтобы стоять и служить во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, его и его сыновей, во все дни.
ru.B: Ведь именно его, его и его сыновей, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, избрал из всех твоих колен, чтобы они стояли и служили во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} всегда.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, выбрал священников и их потомков из всех твоих племён. Они должны стоять перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} и служить во {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя всегда.

ja.L: あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、あなたのすべての部族の中から彼を選ばれたからである。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって立って仕えるために、彼とその子らが、すべての日々に。
ja.B: あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、あなたのすべての部族の中から彼を選ばれた。彼とその子孫が、いつまでも{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって立ち、仕えるためである。
ja.R: あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、あなたのすべての部族の中から、祭司たちとその子孫を選ばれた。彼らは、いつまでも神の前に立ち、神の名によって仕えるのである。

uk.L: Бо його вибрав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, з усіх твоїх племен, щоб стояти, служачи в імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, його і його синів, по всі дні.
uk.B: З усіх твоїх племен саме його вибрав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, його і його синів, щоб стояти й служити в імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} повсякчас.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, вибрав священників і їхніх нащадків з усіх твоїх племен. Вони мають стояти перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} і служити в {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя повсякчас.

id.L: Sebab dialah yang dipilih {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, dari antara segala sukumu, untuk berdiri melayani demi nama {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, dia dan anak-anaknya, sepanjang masa.
id.B: Sebab dialah yang telah dipilih {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, dari antara segala sukumu, dia dan anak-anaknya, untuk berdiri dan melayani demi nama {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} untuk selama-lamanya.
id.R: {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, memilih para imam dan keturunan mereka dari semua suku kalian. Mereka harus berdiri di hadapan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} dan melayani atas nama-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} untuk selama-lamanya.

zh.L: 因为{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}从你的众支派中拣选了他，叫他和他的子孙永远侍立，奉{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的名事奉。
zh.B: 因为{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}正是从你所有的支派中拣选了他和他的子孙，使他们永远侍立，奉{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的名事奉。
zh.R: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}从你们所有的支派中选出了祭司和他们的后代。他们要永远站在{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}面前，奉{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的名事奉{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。

tl.L: Sapagkat siya ang pinili {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} iyong Diyos mula sa lahat ng iyong mga lipi, upang tumayo at maglingkod sa pangalan {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, siya at ang kaniyang mga anak, sa lahat ng araw.
tl.B: Siya ang pinili {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos mula sa lahat ng inyong mga lipi, siya at ang kaniyang mga anak, upang tumayo at maglingkod sa pangalan {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} magpakailanman.
tl.R: Pinili {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos ang mga pari at ang kanilang mga inapo mula sa lahat ng inyong mga lipi. Tatayo sila sa harap {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} at maglilingkod sa {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} pangalan magpakailanman.

pa.L: ਕਿਉਂਕਿ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਗੋਤਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਚੁਣਿਆ ਹੈ, ਕਿ ਉਹ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਖੜ੍ਹਾ ਹੋਵੇ, ਉਹ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ, ਸਾਰੇ ਦਿਨ।
pa.B: ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਗੋਤਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਉਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਪੁੱਤਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਚੁਣਿਆ ਹੈ, ਕਿ ਉਹ ਸਦਾ ਲਈ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਨ।
pa.R: {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਗੋਤਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਜਾਜਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੰਤਾਨ ਨੂੰ ਚੁਣਿਆ ਹੈ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਕੰਮ ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਹੈ।

decisions.choice: him ... he and his sons: Levi's line of priests, chosen from among the tribes
decisions.reason: "Him" comes first in the sentence, for emphasis: of all the tribes, the LORD chose this one. It points back to the priest of verses 3-4 and to the tribe behind him; "his sons" are his descendants after him. 21:5 says the same of "the priests, the sons of Levi".

decisions.choice: to stand to minister: to stand in attendance and serve
decisions.reason: A servant stood before his master, ready to act. The priests stand before the LORD to serve him at the altar (10:8; 17:12).

decisions.choice: in the name of the LORD: as his servants, by his authority
decisions.reason: To serve or bless "in the name" of the LORD is to act for him and with his authority, not on one's own (10:8; 21:5).

decisions.choice: all the days: always, from one generation to the next
decisions.reason: The phrase means for all time; the choice of Levi's line is not for one lifetime only.

decisions.choice: it is he whom ...; the priests and their descendants; stand before him
decisions.reason: Balanced shows the emphasis of "him", placed first in the Hebrew, with "it is he whom". Readable names the priests for "him", which might otherwise seem to mean a single man, and says before whom they stand.

decisions.choice: "神の前に", "神の名によって" with no span for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}
decisions.reason: Japanese has no deity_pronoun spans; an unspanned "主" would read as the divine name, so the pronoun becomes "神", as DEU-2.

decisions.choice: 神 (default), 上帝 (reader setting)
decisions.reason: The Chinese reader setting god_term ("神" by default, "上帝" for readers who choose it) applies to every word for God. The English has no such setting.

decisions.choice: "siya ... siya at ang kaniyang mga anak" (L, B); "ang mga pari at ang kanilang mga inapo" (R)
decisions.reason: Levi's line of priests, chosen from among the tribes (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "tumayo at maglingkod"; "Tatayo sila sa harap" (R)
decisions.reason: To stand in attendance and serve (m2), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "sa pangalan ng PANGINOON"
decisions.reason: As his servants, by his authority (m3).

decisions.choice: "sa lahat ng araw" (L); "magpakailanman" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Always, from one generation to the next (m4).

source.text: וְכִֽי־יָבֹ֨א הַלֵּוִ֜י מֵאַחַ֤ד שְׁעָרֶ֨יךָ֙ מִכָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ה֖וּא גָּ֣ר שָׁ֑ם וּבָא֙ בְּכָל־אַוַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And if comes the Levite from one of your gates from all Israel where he [is] sojourning there, and he comes with all [the] desire of his soul to the place which will choose Yahweh,

en.L: And if the Levite comes from one of your gates out of all Israel, where he is sojourning, and he comes with all the desire of his soul to the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose,
en.B: Suppose a Levite comes from one of your towns anywhere in Israel where he has been living, and he comes because he longs with all his heart to go to the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose,
en.R: A Levite may be living in one of your towns somewhere in Israel. He may want with all his heart to go to the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose.

es.L: Y si el levita viene de una de tus puertas, de todo Israel, donde reside como forastero, y viene con todo el deseo de su alma al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escoja,
es.B: Supongamos que un levita viene de una de tus ciudades, de cualquier parte de Israel donde haya estado viviendo, y viene porque anhela con todo su corazón ir al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escoja,
es.R: Un levita puede estar viviendo en una de tus ciudades, en algún lugar de Israel. Puede que desee con todo su corazón ir al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escoja.

fr.L: Et si le Lévite vient de l’une de tes portes, de tout Israël, où il séjourne, et qu’il vienne, de tout le désir de son âme, au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira,
fr.B: Supposons qu’un Lévite vienne de l’une de tes villes, n’importe où en Israël, où il résidait, et qu’il vienne parce qu’il désire de tout son cœur aller au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira,
fr.R: Un Lévite peut habiter dans l’une de tes villes, quelque part en Israël. Il peut désirer de tout son cœur aller au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira.

sw.L: Na Mlawi akija kutoka katika mojawapo ya malango yako, kutoka Israeli yote, mahali anapokaa kama mgeni, akaja kwa shauku yote ya nafsi yake mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapachagua,
sw.B: Tuseme Mlawi anakuja kutoka katika mmojawapo wa miji yako popote katika Israeli alipokuwa akiishi, naye anakuja kwa sababu anatamani kwa moyo wake wote kwenda mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapachagua,
sw.R: Huenda Mlawi akawa anaishi katika mmojawapo wa miji yako mahali fulani katika Israeli. Huenda akatamani kwa moyo wake wote kwenda mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapachagua.

vi.L: Và nếu người Lê-vi từ một trong các cổng [thành] của ngươi, khắp Y-sơ-ra-ên, là nơi người ấy đang tạm trú, đến với tất cả lòng ao ước của mình đến nơi mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chọn,
vi.B: Giả sử một người Lê-vi từ một thành nào đó trong khắp Y-sơ-ra-ên, nơi người ấy đang cư ngụ, đến nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chọn vì hết lòng ao ước được đến đó,
vi.R: Có thể một người Lê-vi đang sống trong một thành nào đó của anh em ở bất cứ đâu trong Y-sơ-ra-ên. Người ấy hết lòng muốn đến nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chọn.

ko.L: 그리고 온 이스라엘 가운데 네 성문들 중 어느 한 곳, 곧 그가 나그네로 살던 곳에서 레위인이 나와서, 그의 마음이 몹시 원하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 택하실 곳으로 오면,
ko.B: 어떤 레위인이 이스라엘 어디든 자기가 머물러 살던 성읍을 떠나, 간절한 마음으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 택하실 곳으로 온다고 하자.
ko.R: 어떤 레위인이 이스라엘 어느 성읍에서 살고 있을 수 있습니다. 그런데 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 택하실 곳으로 가기를 진심으로 원할 수도 있습니다.

pt.L: E, se o levita vier de uma das tuas portas, de todo Israel, onde ele mora como imigrante, e vier com todo o desejo da sua alma ao lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} escolher,
pt.B: Suponhamos que um levita venha de uma das tuas cidades, de qualquer parte de Israel onde estiver morando, e venha porque deseja de todo o coração ir ao lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} escolher,
pt.R: Pode ser que um levita esteja morando numa das tuas cidades, em qualquer parte de Israel. Ele pode querer de todo o coração ir ao lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} escolher.

am.L: ሌዋዊውም በእንግድነት ከሚኖርበት ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ከደጆችህ ከአንዱ ቢመጣ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ወደሚመርጠውም ስፍራ በነፍሱ ፍላጎት ሁሉ ቢመጣ፣
am.B: አንድ ሌዋዊ በእስራኤል ውስጥ ይኖርበት ከነበረው ከማንኛውም ከተማህ ተነሥቶ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ወደሚመርጠው ስፍራ ለመሄድ በሙሉ ልቡ ስለ ናፈቀ ቢመጣ፣
am.R: አንድ ሌዋዊ በእስራኤል ውስጥ በአንዱ ከተማህ ይኖር ይሆናል። እርሱም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ወደሚመርጠው ስፍራ ለመሄድ በሙሉ ልቡ ይፈልግ ይሆናል።

hi.L: और यदि कोई लेवी सारे इस्राएल में से तुम्हारे किसी फाटक से, जहाँ वह परदेशी होकर रहता है, आए, और अपने प्राण की सारी इच्छा से उस स्थान को आए जिसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} चुनेंगे,
hi.B: मान लो कि कोई लेवी इस्राएल में कहीं भी तुम्हारे किसी नगर से, जहाँ वह रहता आया है, आए, और वह इसलिए आए कि वह पूरे मन से उस स्थान को जाना चाहता है जिसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} चुनेंगे,
hi.R: हो सकता है कि कोई लेवी इस्राएल में कहीं तुम्हारे किसी नगर में रहता हो। वह पूरे मन से उस जगह को जाना चाहे जिसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} चुनेंगे।

ru.L: И если придёт левит из одних из твоих ворот, из всего Израиля, где он живёт как пришелец, и придёт по всему желанию своей души на место, которое изберёт {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}},
ru.B: Допустим, левит придёт из одного из твоих городов, откуда-нибудь из Израиля, где он жил, и придёт потому, что всем сердцем желает быть на месте, которое изберёт {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}},
ru.R: Левит может жить в одном из твоих городов где-нибудь в Израиле. Он может всем сердцем захотеть пойти на место, которое выберет {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: また、もしレビ人が、全イスラエルの中の、彼が寄留しているあなたの門のうちの一つから来て、心の願いのすべてをもって、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が選ばれる場所に来るなら、
ja.B: また、イスラエルのどこであれ、あなたの町の一つに住んでいるレビ人が、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が選ばれる場所に行きたいと心から願って、そこに来るなら、
ja.R: レビ人が、イスラエルのどこかの町に住んでいるとする。その人が、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が選ばれる場所に行きたいと心から願うかもしれない。

uk.L: А якщо левит прийде з однієї з твоїх брам з усього Ізраїлю, де він мешкає як приходько, і прийде з усім бажанням своєї душі до місця, яке вибере {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}},
uk.B: Припустімо, левит прийде з одного з твоїх міст будь-де в Ізраїлі, де він жив, і прийде тому, що всім серцем прагне піти до місця, яке вибере {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}},
uk.R: Левит може жити в одному з твоїх міст десь в Ізраїлі. Він може всім серцем прагнути піти до місця, яке вибере {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

id.L: Dan apabila seorang Lewi datang dari salah satu gerbangmu, dari seluruh Israel, tempat ia tinggal sebagai pendatang, dan ia datang dengan segala keinginan hatinya ke tempat yang akan dipilih {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}},
id.B: Andaikata seorang Lewi datang dari salah satu kotamu di mana pun di Israel, tempat ia tinggal, dan ia datang karena dengan sepenuh hati ia rindu pergi ke tempat yang akan dipilih {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}},
id.R: Mungkin ada orang Lewi yang tinggal di salah satu kota kalian di suatu tempat di Israel. Ia mungkin ingin dengan sepenuh hati pergi ke tempat yang akan dipilih {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}.

zh.L: 若有一个利未人从以色列中你的任何一座城门之内，就是他寄居的地方出来，满心愿意地来到{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}所要选择的地方，
zh.B: 假如有一个利未人，从他在以色列境内居住的任何一座城出来，因为他一心渴望到{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}将要选择的地方去，
zh.R: 也许有一个利未人住在以色列的某一座城里。他可能一心想到{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}将要选择的地方去。

tl.L: At kung ang isang Levita ay dumating mula sa isa sa iyong mga pintuang-bayan saanman sa Israel, kung saan siya nakikipamayan, at dumating siya nang buong nais ng kaniyang kaluluwa sa lugar na pipiliin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}},
tl.B: Ipagpalagay na ang isang Levita ay dumating mula sa isa sa inyong mga bayan saanman sa Israel kung saan siya naninirahan, at dumating siya dahil nananabik siya nang buong puso na pumunta sa lugar na pipiliin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}},
tl.R: Maaaring may isang Levitang naninirahan sa isa sa inyong mga bayan saanman sa Israel. Maaaring nais niya nang buong puso na pumunta sa lugar na pipiliin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਲੇਵੀ ਸਾਰੇ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਫਾਟਕਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਤੋਂ ਆਵੇ, ਜਿੱਥੇ ਉਹ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਵਾਂਗ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਾਨ ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਇੱਛਾ ਨਾਲ ਉਸ ਥਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਵੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਚੁਣਨਗੇ,
pa.B: ਮੰਨ ਲਓ ਕੋਈ ਲੇਵੀ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਤੇ ਵੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਨਗਰ ਤੋਂ, ਜਿੱਥੇ ਉਹ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ, ਆਵੇ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਇਸ ਲਈ ਆਵੇ ਕਿ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਮਨ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਉਸ ਥਾਂ ਜਾਣ ਨੂੰ ਤਰਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਹੜੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਚੁਣਨਗੇ,
pa.R: ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਕੋਈ ਲੇਵੀ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਨਗਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਵੇ। ਸ਼ਾਇਦ ਉਹ ਦਿਲੋਂ ਚਾਹੇ ਕਿ ਉਸ ਥਾਂ ਜਾਵੇ ਜਿਹੜੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਚੁਣਨਗੇ।

decisions.choice: and if: a new case, running to verse 8
decisions.reason: The verse opens a case about the Levites who are not serving at the chosen place: the condition is in this verse, the right he is given follows in verses 7-8.

decisions.choice: your gates; sojourning: the towns where a Levite lived without land of his own
decisions.reason: "Gates" means the towns themselves (12:12; 14:27). The verb is the one used of a resident foreigner: someone who lives in a place without owning land there. Since Levi had no land (verses 1-2), a Levite lived in other people's towns (Judges 17:7; 19:1).

decisions.choice: with all the desire of his soul: because he longs to, of his own free will
decisions.reason: The "soul" here is the self with its desires (12:15, 20). He comes because he wants to serve, not because he is sent.

decisions.choice: the place the LORD will choose: the one place of worship of chapter 12
decisions.reason: With sacrifice brought to one chosen place (12:5-14), Levites living in the towns had no altar near them. This law gives any of them who comes there the right to serve.

decisions.choice: towns; where he has been living; longs with all his heart
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "towns" for "gates", and say plainly what "sojourning" and "all the desire of his soul" mean. Readable makes the condition two short sentences of its own.

decisions.choice: "나그네로 살던" (Literal), "머물러 살던" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one behind "나그네" (ger): a Levite lived in the towns without land of his own. The Literal keeps the link.

decisions.choice: mora como imigrante (L)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one from which the word for the resident foreigner comes (m2), so Literal says "morar como imigrante", as Leviticus 19:33 does, linking it to "o imigrante"; Balanced and Readable say "morar", as the English says "living".

decisions.choice: "At kung" (L); "Ipagpalagay na" (B); "Maaaring" (R)
decisions.reason: A new case, running to verse 8 (m1).

decisions.choice: "mga pintuang-bayan ... nakikipamayan" (L); "mga bayan ... naninirahan" (B, R)

source.text: וְשֵׁרֵ֕ת בְּשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו כְּכָל־אֶחָיו֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הָעֹמְדִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and he shall minister in [the] name of Yahweh his God like all his brothers the Levites who [are] standing there before Yahweh.

en.L: then he shall minister in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, like all his brothers the Levites who stand there before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: he may serve in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God just as all the other Levites do who stand there before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then he may serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God there, just like all the other Levites who serve in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} there.

es.L: entonces ministrará en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, como todos sus hermanos los levitas que están allí delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: podrá servir en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, igual que todos los demás levitas que están allí delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Entonces podrá servir allí {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios, igual que todos los demás levitas que sirven allí delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: alors il servira au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu, comme tous ses frères les Lévites qui se tiennent là devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: il pourra servir au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu, tout comme les autres Lévites qui se tiennent là devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors il pourra servir là-bas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu, comme tous les autres Lévites qui servent devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à cet endroit.

sw.L: ndipo atahudumu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, kama ndugu zake wote Walawi wanaosimama huko mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: anaweza kuhudumu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, sawa na Walawi wengine wote wanaosimama huko mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ndipo anaweza kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake huko, sawa na Walawi wengine wote wanaohudumu huko mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: thì người ấy sẽ phục vụ trong danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời mình, như tất cả anh em người, là những người Lê-vi đứng tại đó trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: thì người ấy được phục vụ trong danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời mình, như mọi người Lê-vi khác đang đứng phục vụ tại đó trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Khi đó, người ấy được phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời mình tại đó, như mọi người Lê-vi khác đang phục vụ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그는 거기에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 서 있는 그의 모든 형제 레위인들처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 자기 하나님의 이름으로 섬길 것이다.
ko.B: 그는 거기에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 서서 섬기는 다른 모든 레위인처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 자기 하나님의 이름으로 섬길 수 있다.
ko.R: 그러면 그는 거기에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 섬기는 다른 모든 레위인처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 자기 하나님을 섬길 수 있습니다.

pt.L: então ele servirá em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus, como todos os seus irmãos levitas que estão ali diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: ele poderá servir em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus, assim como todos os outros levitas que estão ali diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Então ele pode servir ali {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, como todos os outros levitas que servem diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

am.L: በዚያ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት እንደሚቆሙት እንደ ሌዋውያን ወንድሞቹ ሁሉ በአምላኩ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም ያገለግላል።
am.B: በዚያ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት እንደሚቆሙት እንደ ሌሎቹ ሌዋውያን ሁሉ እርሱም በአምላኩ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም ሊያገለግል ይችላል።
am.R: ከዚያም በዚያ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት እንደሚያገለግሉት እንደ ሌሎቹ ሌዋውያን ሁሉ አምላኩን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} በዚያ ሊያገለግል ይችላል።

hi.L: तो वह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के नाम से सेवा करे, अपने उन सब लेवी भाइयों के समान जो वहाँ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने खड़े रहते हैं।
hi.B: तो वह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के नाम से वैसे ही सेवा कर सकता है जैसे वे सब दूसरे लेवी करते हैं जो वहाँ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने खड़े रहते हैं।
hi.R: तब वह वहाँ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की सेवा कर सकता है, ठीक उन दूसरे लेवियों की तरह जो वहाँ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने सेवा करते हैं।

ru.L: то пусть служит во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, своего Бога, как все его братья левиты, которые стоят там пред {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: он может служить во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, своего Бога, так же, как все остальные левиты, которые стоят там перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Тогда он может служить там {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, своему Богу, так же, как все остальные левиты, которые служат там перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: 彼は、そこで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前に立っているレビ人である彼のすべての兄弟たちと同じように、彼の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって仕えなければならない。
ja.B: 彼は、そこで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前に立って仕えているほかのすべてのレビ人と同じように、自分の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって仕えてよい。
ja.R: そのときは、そこで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前で仕えているほかのレビ人と同じように、その人も自分の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に仕えてよい。

uk.L: то нехай служить в імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, свого Бога, як усі його брати левити, що стоять там перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: він може служити в імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, свого Бога, так само як усі інші левити, що стоять там перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Тоді він може служити там {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, своєму Богові, так само як усі інші левити, що служать там перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}.

id.L: ia boleh melayani demi nama {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahnya, seperti semua saudaranya orang Lewi yang berdiri di sana di hadapan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}.
id.B: ia boleh melayani demi nama {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahnya, sama seperti semua saudaranya, orang Lewi, yang berdiri di sana di hadapan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}.
id.R: Kalau begitu, ia boleh melayani {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahnya, di sana, sama seperti semua orang Lewi lain yang melayani di hadapan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} di sana.

zh.L: 他就可以奉{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}他的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的名事奉，像他所有的弟兄利未人在那里侍立在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}面前一样。
zh.B: 他就可以奉{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}他的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的名事奉，与所有在那里侍立在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}面前的其他利未人一样。
zh.R: 那么他就可以在那里事奉{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}他的{{god_term:神|上帝}}，和在那里侍立在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}面前的其他利未人一样。

tl.L: ay maglilingkod siya sa pangalan {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} kaniyang Diyos, gaya ng lahat ng kaniyang mga kapatid na Levita na nakatayo roon sa harap {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}.
tl.B: maaari siyang maglingkod sa pangalan {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} kaniyang Diyos gaya ng lahat ng ibang Levitang nakatayo roon sa harap {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}.
tl.R: Kung gayon ay maaari siyang maglingkod doon {{divine_name:sa PANGINOONG|kay Yahweh na}} kaniyang Diyos, gaya ng lahat ng ibang Levitang naglilingkod doon sa harap {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}.

pa.L: ਤਾਂ ਉਹ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ, ਆਪਣੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਲੇਵੀ ਭਰਾਵਾਂ ਵਾਂਗ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਉੱਥੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੇ ਅੱਗੇ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ।
pa.B: ਤਾਂ ਉਹ ਵੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਸੇ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਉੱਥੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੀ ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਬਾਕੀ ਸਾਰੇ ਲੇਵੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।
pa.R: ਤਦ ਉਹ ਉੱਥੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਬਿਲਕੁਲ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਬਾਕੀ ਲੇਵੀਆਂ ਵਾਂਗ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਉੱਥੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।

decisions.choice: he shall minister: he has the right to serve
decisions.reason: The verb sets out what follows from the case of verse 6: the Levite is to be allowed to serve, and those already there may not turn him away.

decisions.choice: the Levites who stand there before the LORD: Levites serving at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: "Standing before the LORD" and "ministering in his name" are the words used of the priests in verse 5. Deuteronomy calls the priests "the priests, the Levites" and does not draw the line between priests and other Levites that Numbers 3-4 and 18 draw. The text does not say whether this Levite serves as a priest or in the other work of the sanctuary.

decisions.choice: his brothers: his fellow members of the tribe
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means kinsmen, the other Levites.

decisions.choice: he may serve; the other Levites
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "may serve" to bring out that this is a right granted to him, and say "the other Levites" for "his brothers the Levites". The Balanced sentence, begun in verse 6, has no "then".

decisions.choice: "maglilingkod siya" (L); "maaari siyang maglingkod" (B, R)
decisions.reason: He has the right to serve (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "na nakatayo roon sa harap ng PANGINOON"
decisions.reason: Levites serving at the sanctuary (m2).

decisions.choice: "kaniyang mga kapatid na Levita" (L); "ibang Levita" (B, R)
decisions.reason: His fellow members of the tribe (m3), as English (en1).

source.text: חֵ֥לֶק כְּחֵ֖לֶק יֹאכֵ֑לוּ לְבַ֥ד מִמְכָּרָ֖יו עַל־הָאָבֽוֹת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Portion like portion they shall eat, besides his sales upon the fathers.

en.L: Portion like portion they shall eat, besides his sales by the fathers.
en.B: They are to eat equal shares, even if he has money from selling what came to him from his family.
en.R: He must get the same share of food as the other Levites, even if he has money from selling his family's property.

es.L: Porción igual a porción comerán, aparte de sus ventas por los padres.
es.B: Comerán porciones iguales, aunque él tenga dinero de la venta de lo que le vino de su familia.
es.R: Debe recibir la misma parte de comida que los demás levitas, aunque tenga dinero por haber vendido las propiedades de su familia.

fr.L: Part pour part ils mangeront, outre ses ventes par les pères.
fr.B: Ils mangeront des parts égales, même s’il a de l’argent provenant de la vente de ce qui lui venait de sa famille.
fr.R: Il doit recevoir la même part de nourriture que les autres Lévites, même s’il a de l’argent parce qu’il a vendu les biens de sa famille.

sw.L: Fungu kwa fungu watakula, mbali na mauzo yake kwa njia ya baba.
sw.B: Watakula mafungu sawa, hata kama ana fedha kutokana na kuuza kile alichokipata kwa jamaa yake.
sw.R: Lazima apate fungu la chakula sawa na Walawi wengine, hata kama ana fedha kwa sababu aliuza mali ya jamaa yake.

vi.L: Phần như phần, họ sẽ ăn, ngoài [tiền] bán [tài sản] của người ấy theo nhà cha.
vi.B: Họ phải được ăn những phần bằng nhau, dù người ấy có tiền bán tài sản thừa hưởng từ gia đình mình.
vi.R: Người ấy phải được phần thức ăn bằng với những người Lê-vi khác, dù người ấy có tiền bán tài sản của gia đình mình.

ko.L: 그들은 몫과 같은 몫을 먹을 것이다. 그가 조상[의 것을] 판 것은 별도이다.
ko.B: 그는 다른 레위인들과 똑같은 몫을 먹어야 한다. 집안에서 물려받은 것을 팔아서 생긴 돈이 그에게 있더라도 그러하다.
ko.R: 그는 다른 레위인들과 똑같은 몫의 음식을 받아야 합니다. 집안의 재산을 팔아서 생긴 돈이 그에게 있어도 그렇습니다.

pt.L: Porção igual comerão, à parte das suas vendas segundo os pais.
pt.B: Eles comerão porções iguais, mesmo que ele tenha dinheiro da venda do que recebeu da sua família.
pt.R: Ele deve receber a mesma porção de comida que os outros levitas, mesmo que tenha dinheiro da venda das propriedades da sua família.

am.L: የአባቶቹን [ንብረት] ከሸጠበት ገንዘብ ሌላ ድርሻ እንደ ድርሻ ይበላሉ።
am.B: የቤተሰቡን ንብረት ሸጦ ያገኘው ገንዘብ ቢኖረውም እንኳ እኩል ድርሻ ይበላሉ።
am.R: የቤተሰቡን ንብረት ሸጦ ገንዘብ ቢኖረውም እንኳ እንደ ሌሎቹ ሌዋውያን እኩል የምግብ ድርሻ ማግኘት አለበት።

hi.L: भाग के बराबर भाग वे खाएँ, पितरों की ओर से [मिली वस्तुओं की] उसकी बिक्री के अलावा।
hi.B: उन सबको बराबर हिस्सा खाने को मिले, चाहे उसके पास अपने परिवार से मिली संपत्ति बेचकर पाए हुए रुपये भी हों।
hi.R: उसे भी दूसरे लेवियों जितना ही भोजन का हिस्सा मिले, चाहे उसके पास अपने परिवार की संपत्ति बेचकर मिले रुपये हों।

ru.L: Часть как часть пусть они едят, кроме того, что он выручил от продажи отцовского.
ru.B: Они должны получать равные доли, даже если у него есть деньги от продажи того, что досталось ему от семьи.
ru.R: Он должен получать такую же долю пищи, как и другие левиты, даже если у него есть деньги от продажи семейного имущества.

ja.L: 分は分と同じに、彼らは食べる。父祖による彼の売却[の分]は別として。
ja.B: 彼らは等しい分を食べる。たとえ彼が家族から受け継いだ物を売って得たお金を持っていても、そうである。
ja.R: その人は、ほかのレビ人と同じだけの食べ物を受け取らなければならない。家族の財産を売ったお金を持っていても、それは変わらない。

uk.L: Частку як частку вони їстимуть, окрім того, що він продав із батьківського.
uk.B: Вони мають їсти рівні частки, навіть якщо він має гроші від продажу того, що дісталося йому від родини.
uk.R: Він має отримувати таку саму частку їжі, як інші левити, навіть якщо має гроші від продажу родинного майна.

id.L: Bagian yang sama haruslah mereka makan, selain apa yang didapatnya dari penjualan milik nenek moyangnya.
id.B: Mereka harus mendapat bagian makanan yang sama, walaupun ia mempunyai uang dari penjualan milik keluarganya.
id.R: Ia harus mendapat bagian makanan yang sama dengan orang Lewi yang lain, walaupun ia mempunyai uang dari penjualan harta keluarganya.

zh.L: 他们要吃一样的份，这是他卖祖业所得之外的。
zh.B: 他们要分得同样的食物，即使他已经从卖家产中得了钱。
zh.R: 他应该和其他利未人分到一样多的食物，即使他已经卖了家里的产业，得了钱。

tl.L: Bahaging gaya ng bahagi ang kanilang kakainin, bukod sa kaniyang mga pinagbilhan mula sa mga ama.
