Its Chinese wording is kept at each level where the Hebrew says the same, with the divine name for "主" (the Greek has kyrios) and the Hebrew's singular "you" ("你的", "为你") where Acts has the plural. Acts adds "in all things, whatever he says"; the Hebrew has only "to him you shall listen", so that is all the Chinese says. Acts' deity_pronoun spans are not kept: there the prophet is read of Jesus, and the English has no span here.

decisions.choice: 同胞
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced, the inclusive "同胞" (fellow Israelites) by default, the traditional "弟兄" as the alternative; Literal keeps "弟兄", Readable "同胞".

decisions.choice: "Isang propeta" placed first (L)
decisions.reason: In contrast to the diviners (m1).

decisions.choice: "na gaya ko"
decisions.reason: A prophet who stands between God and the people as Moses did (m2).

decisions.choice: "isang propeta"
decisions.reason: One prophet in the wording; it can mean each true prophet in turn and was also read of one prophet still to come (m3).

decisions.choice: the verse as a whole
decisions.reason: Cited in Acts 3:22-23 and 7:37 (m4).

decisions.choice: "mga kapatid" (L); "mga kababayan" (B, R) with no gender span; "Bibigyan kayo" (R)
decisions.reason: An Israelite, and all the people are to obey (m5), as English (en1, en2); *kapatid* and *kababayan* name no gender.

decisions.choice: "ਮੇਰੇ ਵਰਗਾ ਇੱਕ ਨਬੀ ... ਖੜ੍ਹਾ ਕਰਨਗੇ" (L), "ਉਠਾਉਣਗੇ" (B), "ਦੇਣਗੇ" (R)
decisions.reason: Matches Acts 3:22 and 7:37 in this translation.

source.text: כְּכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁאַ֜לְתָּ מֵעִ֨ם יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ בְּחֹרֵ֔ב בְּי֥וֹם הַקָּהָ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֣א אֹסֵ֗ף לִשְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ אֶת־קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י וְאֶת־הָאֵ֨שׁ הַגְּדֹלָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את לֹֽא־אֶרְאֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד וְלֹ֥א אָמֽוּת׃

records.literal_gloss: according to all that you asked from with Yahweh your God at Horeb on [the] day of the assembly, saying, Not let me again hear [the] voice of Yahweh my God, and the fire the great the this not let me see again, and not I will die.

en.L: according to all that you asked of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying, 'Let me not hear again the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God, and this great fire let me not see anymore, so that I do not die.'
en.B: It is what you requested from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, when you said, 'I must not hear the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God again or look at this great fire any longer, or I will die.'
en.R: This is what you asked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God for at Mount Horeb, on the day the people gathered there. You said, 'Do not let me hear the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God again or see this great fire any more. If I do, I will die.'

es.L: conforme a todo lo que pediste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios en Horeb el día de la asamblea, diciendo: “Que no vuelva yo a oír la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} mi Dios, ni vea más este gran fuego, para que no muera”.
es.B: Es lo que pediste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios en Horeb el día de la asamblea, cuando dijiste: “No debo oír otra vez la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} mi Dios ni mirar más este gran fuego, o moriré”.
es.R: Esto es lo que le pediste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios en el monte Horeb, el día en que el pueblo se reunió allí. Dijiste: “No quiero volver a oír la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} mi Dios ni ver más este gran fuego. Si lo hago, moriré”.

fr.L: selon tout ce que tu as demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu à l’Horeb, le jour de l’assemblée, en disant : “Que je n’entende plus la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} mon Dieu, et que je ne voie plus ce grand feu, afin que je ne meure pas.”
fr.B: C’est ce que tu as demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu à l’Horeb, le jour de l’assemblée, quand tu as dit : “Je ne dois plus entendre la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} mon Dieu ni regarder plus longtemps ce grand feu, sinon je mourrai.”
fr.R: C’est ce que tu as demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu au mont Horeb, le jour où le peuple s’y était rassemblé. Tu as dit : “Je ne veux plus entendre la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} mon Dieu ni voir ce grand feu. Sinon, je vais mourir.”

sw.L: kulingana na yote uliyomwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako huko Horebu siku ya kusanyiko, ukisema, 'Nisisikie tena sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, wala nisiuone tena moto huu mkubwa, nisije nikafa.'
sw.B: Ndivyo ulivyomwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako huko Horebu siku ya kusanyiko, uliposema, 'Sipaswi kusikia tena sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu wala kuutazama tena moto huu mkubwa, la sivyo nitakufa.'
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo ulivyomwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kule Mlima Horebu, siku watu walipokusanyika huko. Ulisema, 'Sitaki kusikia tena sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu wala kuuona tena moto huu mkubwa. Nikifanya hivyo, nitakufa.'

vi.L: theo mọi điều ngươi đã cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi tại Hô-rếp vào ngày nhóm họp, rằng: 'Xin cho tôi đừng nghe tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời tôi nữa, và đừng cho tôi thấy ngọn lửa lớn này nữa, để tôi khỏi chết.'
vi.B: Đó chính là điều anh em đã xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em tại Hô-rếp vào ngày toàn dân nhóm họp, khi anh em nói: 'Tôi không thể nghe tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời tôi thêm nữa, cũng không thể nhìn ngọn lửa lớn này thêm nữa, kẻo tôi chết mất.'
vi.R: Đây là điều anh em đã xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em tại núi Hô-rếp, vào ngày dân chúng nhóm lại ở đó. Anh em đã nói: 'Xin đừng để tôi nghe tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời tôi nữa, hay thấy ngọn lửa lớn này nữa. Nếu không, tôi sẽ chết.'

ko.L: 이것은 총회의 날에 호렙에서 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님께 구한 모든 것대로이다. 그때 너는 '내가 다시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 내 하나님의 목소리를 듣지 않고, 이 큰 불을 더는 보지 않겠다. 그래야 내가 죽지 않을 것이다' 하고 말하였다.
ko.B: 이것은 너희가 총회의 날에 호렙에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께 구한 바로 그것이다. 그때 너희는 '제가 다시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 제 하나님의 목소리를 듣지 않고, 이 큰 불을 더는 보지 않게 해 주십시오. 그렇지 않으면 제가 죽겠습니다' 하고 말했다.
ko.R: 이것은 여러분이 호렙 산에 모인 날 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께 구한 것입니다. 그때 여러분은 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님의 목소리를 다시는 듣지 않게 해 주십시오. 이 큰 불도 더는 보지 않게 해 주십시오. 그렇지 않으면 우리가 죽겠습니다' 하고 말했습니다.

pt.L: conforme tudo o que pediste {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o teu Deus, em Horebe, no dia da assembleia, dizendo: 'Que eu não volte a ouvir a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o meu Deus, e este grande fogo não veja mais, para que eu não morra.'
pt.B: Foi isso que pediste {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o teu Deus, em Horebe, no dia da assembleia, quando disseste: 'Não posso mais ouvir a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o meu Deus, nem olhar para este grande fogo, senão morrerei.'
pt.R: Foi isso que pediste {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o teu Deus, no monte Horebe, no dia em que o povo se reuniu ali. Disseste: 'Não quero ouvir de novo a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o meu Deus, nem ver mais este grande fogo. Se isso acontecer, vou morrer.'

am.L: ይህም በኮሬብ በጉባኤው ቀን “የአምላኬን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ድምፅ ዳግመኛ አልስማ፤ ይህንም ታላቅ እሳት ከእንግዲህ አልይ፤ እንዳልሞት” ብለህ ከአምላክህ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} እንደ ለመንኸው ሁሉ ነው።
am.B: ይህ በኮሬብ ሕዝቡ በተሰበሰበበት ቀን ከአምላክህ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} የለመንኸው ነው፤ ያን ጊዜ “የአምላኬን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ድምፅ ዳግመኛ ልሰማ ወይም ይህን ታላቅ እሳት ከዚህ በኋላ ልመለከት አይገባኝም፤ አለዚያ እሞታለሁ” ብለህ ነበር።
am.R: ይህ በኮሬብ ተራራ ሕዝቡ በተሰበሰቡበት ቀን አምላክህን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የለመንኸው ነገር ነው። “የአምላኬን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ድምፅ ዳግመኛ አታሰማኝ፤ ይህንም ታላቅ እሳት ከእንግዲህ አታሳየኝ። ይህ ቢሆን እሞታለሁ” ብለህ ነበር።

hi.L: उस सबके अनुसार जो तुमने होरेब में सभा के दिन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर से माँगा था, यह कहकर, 'मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की आवाज़ फिर न सुनूँ, और यह बड़ी आग फिर न देखूँ, ताकि मैं मर न जाऊँ।'
hi.B: यह वही है जो तुमने होरेब में सभा के दिन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर से माँगा था, जब तुमने कहा था, 'मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की आवाज़ फिर न सुनूँ और न यह बड़ी आग फिर देखूँ, नहीं तो मैं मर जाऊँगा।'
hi.R: तुमने होरेब पर्वत पर, उस दिन जब सब लोग वहाँ इकट्ठे हुए थे, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर से यही माँगा था। तुमने कहा था, 'मुझे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की आवाज़ फिर न सुननी पड़े और न यह बड़ी आग फिर देखनी पड़े। यदि ऐसा हुआ, तो मैं मर जाऊँगा।'

ru.L: по всему, о чём ты просил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, твоего Бога, у Хорива в день собрания, говоря: “Пусть я больше не услышу голоса {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, моего Бога, и этого великого огня пусть больше не увижу, чтобы мне не умереть.”
ru.B: Об этом ты и просил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, твоего Бога, у Хорива в день собрания, когда сказал: “Я не должен больше слышать голос {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, моего Бога, и смотреть на этот великий огонь, иначе я умру.”
ru.R: Об этом ты и просил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, твоего Бога, у горы Хорив в тот день, когда там собрался народ. Ты сказал: “Не дай мне больше слышать голос {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, моего Бога, и видеть этот великий огонь. Если это случится, я умру.”

ja.L: それは、集会の日にホレブで、あなたがあなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に求めたすべてのとおりである。あなたは『わたしの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の声を二度と聞かず、この大きな火をもう見ないようにさせてください。わたしが死なないためです』と言った。
ja.B: これは、集会の日にホレブで、あなたがあなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に願ったことである。あなたは『わたしの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の声を二度と聞くことができません。この大きな火をもう見ることもできません。そうすれば、わたしは死んでしまいます』と言った。
ja.R: これは、民がホレブ山に集まった日に、あなたがあなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に願ったことである。あなたは『わたしの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の声を、二度と聞かせないでください。この大きな火も、もう見せないでください。そうでないと、わたしは死んでしまいます』と言った。

uk.L: згідно з усім, чого ти просив у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога, на Хориві в день зібрання, кажучи: “Нехай я більше не чую голосу {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, мого Бога, і цього великого вогню нехай більше не бачу, щоб я не помер.”
uk.B: Саме цього ти просив у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога, на Хориві в день зібрання, коли сказав: “Я не повинен більше чути голосу {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, мого Бога, ані дивитися довше на цей великий вогонь, бо помру.”
uk.R: Саме про це ти просив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога, на горі Хорив того дня, коли народ зібрався там. Ти сказав: “Не дай мені більше чути голосу {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, мого Бога, чи бачити цей великий вогонь. Якщо побачу, то помру.”

id.L: sesuai dengan segala yang kauminta dari {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, di Horeb pada hari perhimpunan, katamu, 'Janganlah aku mendengar lagi suara {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahku, dan api yang besar ini janganlah kulihat lagi, supaya aku jangan mati.'
id.B: Itulah yang kauminta dari {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, di Horeb pada hari perhimpunan, ketika engkau berkata, 'Janganlah aku mendengar lagi suara {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahku, atau melihat api yang besar ini lagi, supaya aku tidak mati.'
id.R: Itulah yang kalian minta dari {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, di gunung Horeb, pada hari semua orang berkumpul di sana. Kalian berkata, 'Jangan biarkan aku mendengar suara {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahku, lagi atau melihat api yang besar ini lagi. Kalau aku mengalaminya, aku akan mati.'

zh.L: 这正合你在何烈山大会的日子向{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}所求的一切，那时你说：‘我不要再听见{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}我的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的声音，也不要再看见这大火，免得我死。’
zh.B: 这正是你在何烈山，在会众聚集的那一天，向{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}所求的。那时你说：‘我不能再听见{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}我的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的声音，也不能再看这大火，不然我就会死。’
zh.R: 这是你在何烈山，在百姓聚集在那里的那一天，向{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}所求的。你说：‘不要让我再听见{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}我的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的声音，也不要让我再看见这大火。不然我就会死。’

tl.L: ayon sa lahat ng hiniling mo {{divine_name:sa PANGINOONG|kay Yahweh na}} iyong Diyos sa Horeb sa araw ng pagtitipon, na sinasabi, 'Huwag ko nang marinig muli ang tinig {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} aking Diyos, at huwag ko nang makita pa ang malaking apoy na ito, upang hindi ako mamatay.'
tl.B: Ito ang hiniling ninyo {{divine_name:sa PANGINOONG|kay Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos sa Horeb noong araw ng pagtitipon, nang sabihin ninyo, 'Hindi ko na dapat marinig muli ang tinig {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} aking Diyos o tingnan pa ang malaking apoy na ito, kung hindi ay mamamatay ako.'
tl.R: Ito ang hiniling ninyo {{divine_name:sa PANGINOONG|kay Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos sa Bundok Horeb noong araw na nagtipon doon ang bayan. Sinabi ninyo, 'Huwag na ninyong iparinig sa akin muli ang tinig {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} aking Diyos o ipakita pa ang malaking apoy na ito. Kung mangyari iyon, mamamatay ako.'

pa.L: ਉਸ ਸਭ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਰੇਬ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭਾ ਦੇ ਦਿਨ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੋਂ ਮੰਗਿਆ ਸੀ, ਇਹ ਆਖ ਕੇ, 'ਮੈਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਫਿਰ ਨਾ ਸੁਣਾਂ, ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਵੱਡੀ ਅੱਗ ਮੈਂ ਹੋਰ ਨਾ ਵੇਖਾਂ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਮੈਂ ਮਰ ਨਾ ਜਾਵਾਂ।'
pa.B: ਇਹ ਉਹੀ ਗੱਲ ਹੈ ਜਿਹੜੀ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਰੇਬ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਕੱਠ ਦੇ ਦਿਨ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੋਂ ਮੰਗੀ ਸੀ, ਜਦ ਤੂੰ ਆਖਿਆ ਸੀ, 'ਮੈਂ ਮੁੜ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਨਾ ਸੁਣਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਾ ਇਹ ਵੱਡੀ ਅੱਗ ਹੋਰ ਵੇਖਾਂ, ਨਹੀਂ ਤਾਂ ਮੈਂ ਮਰ ਜਾਵਾਂਗਾ।'
pa.R: ਤੂੰ ਹੋਰੇਬ ਪਹਾੜ ਉੱਤੇ, ਜਿਸ ਦਿਨ ਸਾਰੇ ਲੋਕ ਉੱਥੇ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਨ, {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੋਂ ਇਹੀ ਮੰਗਿਆ ਸੀ। ਤੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ ਸੀ, 'ਮੈਨੂੰ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਫਿਰ ਨਾ ਸੁਣਨੀ ਪਵੇ, ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਵੱਡੀ ਅੱਗ ਮੁੜ ਨਾ ਵੇਖਣੀ ਪਵੇ। ਜੇ ਇਉਂ ਹੋਇਆ ਤਾਂ ਮੈਂ ਮਰ ਜਾਵਾਂਗਾ।'

decisions.choice: what you asked at Horeb: the people's plea after they heard the ten words
decisions.reason: The story is told in 5:23-28 (and Exodus 20:18-21): terrified by the voice from the fire, the people asked Moses to go near and hear God for them. The prophet of verse 15 is God's answer to that request.

decisions.choice: the day of the assembly: the day all Israel gathered at the mountain
decisions.reason: This is the day the LORD spoke the ten words to the assembled people from the fire (9:10; 10:4).

decisions.choice: you asked; my God; let me not: the people speak as one
decisions.reason: "You" and "I" are singular. The whole people is spoken of, and speaks, as one person.

decisions.choice: and not I will die: so that I do not die
decisions.reason: The last clause gives the reason for the request: to go on hearing God's voice would be death (5:25).

decisions.choice: It is what you requested; I must not hear
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable begin a new sentence here, since verse 15 has already been closed there. Balanced gives the wish "let me not hear" as "I must not hear". Readable says "Mount Horeb", as in 5:2, and says what "the day of the assembly" was.

decisions.choice: "총회" (Literal, Balanced), "모인 날" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Qahal is the term sheet's "총회".

decisions.choice: pediste, disseste (tu); eu, o meu Deus (the people as one)
decisions.reason: The people ask and speak as one person (m3), so Portuguese keeps "tu" for "you asked" and "eu" in the quotation at every level, as the English does. "A assembleia" for the gathered people (m2), as docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md sets it.

decisions.choice: "मैं", "मेरे" with masculine "मर जाऊँगा" for the people speaking as one
decisions.reason: The people speak as one (m3), so Hindi keeps the singular "I" of the Hebrew; the masculine verb is the ordinary Hindi form for a whole people speaking as one.

decisions.choice: The people's words to God in です・ます, as DEU-2 (people to God polite)
decisions.reason: The people are pleading with God; Japanese marks it with polite forms.

decisions.choice: 何烈山
decisions.reason: The glossary's "何烈山" for Horeb at every level, as the English Readable says "Mount Horeb".

decisions.choice: "ayon sa lahat ng hiniling mo ... sa Horeb"
decisions.reason: The people's plea after they heard the ten words (m1).

decisions.choice: "sa araw ng pagtitipon"
decisions.reason: The day all Israel gathered at the mountain (m2).

decisions.choice: "hiniling mo ... aking Diyos ... huwag ko"
decisions.reason: The people speak as one (m3), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "upang hindi ako mamatay"
decisions.reason: So that I do not die (m4).

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י הֵיטִ֖יבוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to me, They have done well [in] what they have spoken.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'They have done well [in] what they have spoken.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'They have spoken well.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'They were right to say this.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Han hecho bien [en] lo que han dicho.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Han hablado bien.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Tienen razón en decir esto.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Ils ont bien fait de dire ce qu’ils ont dit.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Ils ont bien parlé.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Ils ont eu raison de dire cela.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, 'Wamefanya vema [katika] yale waliyoyasema.
sw.B: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, 'Wamesema vema.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia, 'Wako sahihi kusema hivyo.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: 'Chúng đã nói phải.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: 'Họ nói phải lắm.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: 'Họ nói như vậy là đúng.

ko.L: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내게 말씀하셨다. '그들이 말한 것은 잘한 것이다.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내게 말씀하셨다. '그들의 말이 옳다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 제게 말씀하셨습니다. '그들이 그렇게 말한 것은 옳다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: 'Fizeram bem [no] que falaram.
pt.B: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: 'Eles falaram bem.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: 'Eles estão certos em dizer isso.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም እንዲህ አለኝ፦ “በተናገሩት መልካም አድርገዋል።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለኝ፦ “የተናገሩት መልካም ነው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለኝ፦ “ይህን ማለታቸው ትክክል ነው።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझसे कहा, 'जो कुछ उन्होंने कहा है, [उसमें] उन्होंने ठीक किया है।
hi.B: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझसे कहा, 'उन्होंने ठीक कहा है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझसे कहा, 'उनका यह कहना ठीक था।

ru.L: И сказал мне {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: “Хорошо то, что они сказали.
ru.B: Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал мне: “Они хорошо сказали.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал мне: “Они правильно сказали.

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしに言われた。『彼らが語ったことは良い。
ja.B: すると{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしに言われた。『彼らの言ったことはもっともだ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしにこう言われた。『彼らがそう言ったのは正しい。

uk.L: І сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} мені: “Добре вони зробили в тому, що сказали.
uk.B: Тоді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав мені: “Вони добре сказали.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав мені: “Вони мали рацію, коли так сказали.

id.L: Dan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepadaku, 'Baiklah apa yang mereka katakan.
id.B: Lalu {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepadaku, 'Apa yang mereka katakan itu baik.
id.R: {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepadaku, 'Mereka benar mengatakan hal itu.

zh.L: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}对我说：‘他们所说的是好的。
zh.B: 于是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}对我说：‘他们说得对。
zh.R: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}对我说：‘他们这样说是对的。

tl.L: At sinabi sa akin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, 'Mabuti ang kanilang sinabi.
tl.B: Pagkatapos ay sinabi sa akin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, 'Tama ang kanilang sinabi.
tl.R: Sinabi sa akin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, 'Tama sila sa pagsasabi nito.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਆਖਿਆ, 'ਜੋ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਹੈ ਉਸ [ਵਿੱਚ] ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਚੰਗਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ।
pa.B: ਤਦ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਆਖਿਆ, 'ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਠੀਕ ਕਿਹਾ ਹੈ।
pa.R: {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ, 'ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਇਹ ਆਖਣਾ ਸਹੀ ਸੀ।

decisions.choice: they have done well in what they have spoken: the LORD's approval of the people's request
decisions.reason: The same words are reported in 5:28. The people were right to know they could not stand before God's voice, and the LORD granted what they asked.

decisions.choice: the LORD's words run from here to the end of verse 20
decisions.reason: In verses 18-20 the LORD speaks of himself as "I" and of Moses as "you". In verse 21 the LORD is spoken of again in the third person, so Moses' own words most likely take up again there.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks, opened here and closed at the end of verse 20
decisions.reason: The whole chapter is inside Moses' speech, which opened at 5:1. Words he quotes take single quotation marks, so the LORD's words open here and close at the end of verse 20.

decisions.choice: In the LORD's words of verses 17-20, God says "Ta", calls Moses "ngươi" (L) / "con" (B, R) and speaks of Israel as "chúng" (L) / "họ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled address of God to Moses in these books, quoted here inside Moses' speech.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks, opened here and closed at the end of verse 20
decisions.reason: As the English (m2) and as 4:10 and 10:1 set it in Portuguese: Moses' speech, open since 5:1, is in double quotes, so the LORD's words to him take single quotes; in them God says "tu" to Moses.

decisions.choice: ‘ opened here, closed at the end of verse 20
decisions.reason: The whole chapter is inside Moses' speech, so the LORD's words, which run to the end of verse 20, take the inner marks ‘ ’, as the English has single quotation marks.

decisions.choice: "Mabuti ang kanilang sinabi"
decisions.reason: The LORD's approval of the people's request (m1).

decisions.choice: single quotation marks from here to the end of verse 20
decisions.reason: The LORD's words (m2), as English (en1).

source.text: נָבִ֨יא אָקִ֥ים לָהֶ֛ם מִקֶּ֥רֶב אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם כָּמ֑וֹךָ וְנָתַתִּ֤י דְבָרַי֙ בְּפִ֔יו וְדִבֶּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוֶּֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A prophet I will raise up for them from [the] midst of their brothers, like you, and I will put my words in his mouth, and he will speak to them all that I command him.

en.L: A prophet I will raise up for them from the midst of their brothers, like you, and I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I command him.
en.B: From among their {{gender:fellow Israelites|brothers}} I will raise up a prophet for them who is like you. I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words in his mouth, and he will pass on to them all that I command him.
en.R: I will give them a prophet like you from among their own people. I will give him {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words to say, and he will tell them everything I command him.

es.L: Un profeta les levantaré de en medio de sus hermanos, como tú, y pondré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras en su boca, y él les hablará todo lo que yo le mande.
es.B: De entre sus propios compatriotas les levantaré un profeta como tú. Pondré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras en su boca, y él les transmitirá todo lo que yo le mande.
es.R: Les daré un profeta como tú, de su propio pueblo. Le daré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras para que las diga, y él les dirá todo lo que yo le mande.

fr.L: Un prophète, je [le] leur susciterai du milieu de leurs frères, comme toi, et je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles dans sa bouche, et il leur dira tout ce que je lui commanderai.
fr.B: Du milieu de leurs {{gender:compatriotes|frères}}, je leur susciterai un prophète semblable à toi. Je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles dans sa bouche, et il leur transmettra tout ce que je lui commanderai.
fr.R: Je leur donnerai un prophète comme toi, venu de leur propre peuple. Je lui donnerai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles à dire, et il leur dira tout ce que je lui commanderai.

sw.L: Nabii nitawainulia kutoka katikati ya ndugu zao, kama wewe, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitatia maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kinywani mwake, naye atawaambia yote nitakayomwamuru.
sw.B: Kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zao Waisraeli nitawainulia nabii aliye kama wewe. Nitatia maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kinywani mwake, naye atawafikishia yote nitakayomwamuru.
sw.R: Nitawapa nabii kama wewe kutoka miongoni mwa watu wao wenyewe. Nitampa maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ayaseme, naye atawaambia kila kitu nitakachomwamuru.

vi.L: Một nhà tiên tri, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dấy lên cho chúng từ giữa anh em chúng, giống như ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong miệng người ấy, và người ấy sẽ nói với chúng mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho người ấy.
vi.B: Ta sẽ dấy lên cho họ, từ giữa đồng bào của họ, một nhà tiên tri giống như con. Ta sẽ đặt lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong miệng người ấy, và người ấy sẽ truyền lại cho họ mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền dặn.
vi.R: Ta sẽ ban cho họ một nhà tiên tri giống như con, là người trong dân của họ. Ta sẽ cho người ấy lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để nói, và người ấy sẽ nói với họ mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền dặn.

ko.L: 내가 그들을 위하여 그들의 형제들 가운데서 너와 같은 예언자 하나를 세우고, 내 말을 그의 입에 두겠다. 그러면 그는 내가 그에게 명령하는 모든 것을 그들에게 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 그들의 {{gender:동족|형제}} 가운데서 너와 같은 예언자 하나를 그들에게 세워 주겠다. 내가 내 말을 그의 입에 두면, 그는 내가 명령하는 것을 모두 그들에게 전할 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 그들 가운데서 너와 같은 예언자 하나를 그들에게 보내 주겠다. 그가 할 말을 내가 그에게 주겠다. 그러면 그는 내가 명령하는 것을 모두 그들에게 말해 줄 것이다.

pt.L: Um profeta levantarei para eles do meio dos seus irmãos, como tu, e porei as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras na sua boca, e ele lhes falará tudo o que eu lhe ordenar.
pt.B: Dentre os seus {{gender:compatriotas|irmãos}} levantarei para eles um profeta como tu. Porei as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras na boca dele, e ele lhes transmitirá tudo o que eu lhe ordenar.
pt.R: Vou dar a eles um profeta como tu, do meio do próprio povo deles. Vou dar a ele as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras para dizer, e ele vai dizer a eles tudo o que eu mandar.

am.L: ከወንድሞቻቸው መካከል እንደ አንተ ያለ ነቢይ አስነሣላቸዋለሁ፤ ቃሎቼንም በአፉ አኖራለሁ፤ የማዝዘውንም ሁሉ ይነግራቸዋል።
am.B: ከገዛ {{gender:ወገኖቻቸው|ወንድሞቻቸው}} መካከል እንደ አንተ ያለ ነቢይ አስነሣላቸዋለሁ። ቃሎቼን በአፉ አኖራለሁ፤ እርሱም የማዝዘውን ሁሉ ይነግራቸዋል።
am.R: ከገዛ ወገኖቻቸው መካከል እንደ አንተ ያለ ነቢይ እሰጣቸዋለሁ። የሚናገረውን ቃል እሰጠዋለሁ፤ እርሱም ያዘዝኩትን ሁሉ ይነግራቸዋል።

hi.L: मैं उनके लिए उनके भाइयों के बीच में से तुम्हारे जैसा एक भविष्यद्वक्ता खड़ा करूँगा, और अपने वचन उसके मुँह में डालूँगा, और जो कुछ मैं उसे आज्ञा दूँगा, वह सब वह उनसे कहेगा।
hi.B: मैं उनके लिए उनके अपने लोगों में से तुम्हारे जैसा एक भविष्यद्वक्ता खड़ा करूँगा। मैं अपने वचन उसके मुँह में डालूँगा, और जो कुछ मैं उसे आज्ञा दूँगा, वह सब वह उन तक पहुँचाएगा।
hi.R: मैं उनके अपने लोगों में से उन्हें तुम्हारे जैसा एक नबी दूँगा। मैं उसे अपने वचन बोलने को दूँगा, और जो कुछ मैं उसे आज्ञा दूँगा, वह सब वह उन्हें बताएगा।

ru.L: Пророка {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} воздвигну им из среды их братьев, как тебя, и вложу {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} слова в его уста, и он будет говорить им всё, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} повелю ему.
ru.B: Из их народа {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} воздвигну им пророка, подобного тебе. Я вложу {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} слова в его уста, и он передаст им всё, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ему повелю.
ru.R: Я дам им пророка, подобного тебе, из их собственного народа. Я дам ему {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} слова, чтобы он говорил их, и он скажет им всё, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ему повелю.

ja.L: わたしは彼らのために、彼らの兄弟たちのただ中から、あなたのような預言者を起こし、わたしの言葉を彼の口に授ける。彼は、わたしが彼に命じることをすべて彼らに語る。
ja.B: わたしは彼らのために、彼らの同胞の中から、あなたのような預言者を起こす。わたしはその口にわたしの言葉を授ける。彼は、わたしが命じることをすべて彼らに伝える。
ja.R: わたしは彼らに、あなたのような預言者を、彼らと同じイスラエル人の中から与える。わたしは、その預言者に、語るべきわたしの言葉を与える。彼は、わたしが命じることを、すべて彼らに伝える。

uk.L: Пророка підніму їм з-посеред їхніх братів, як ти, і вкладу {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} слова в його уста, і він говоритиме їм усе, що я накажу йому.
uk.B: З-поміж їхніх {{gender:співвітчизників|братів}} я підніму їм пророка, подібного до тебе. Я вкладу {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} слова в його уста, і він передаватиме їм усе, що я йому накажу.
uk.R: Я дам їм пророка, як ти, з-поміж їхнього власного народу. Я дам йому {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} слова, щоб він їх говорив, і він скаже їм усе, що я йому накажу.

id.L: Seorang nabi akan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} bangkitkan bagi mereka dari tengah-tengah saudara-saudara mereka, seperti engkau, dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan menaruh firman-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} di dalam mulutnya, dan ia akan mengatakan kepada mereka segala yang {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} perintahkan kepadanya.
id.B: {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan membangkitkan bagi mereka seorang nabi seperti engkau dari antara saudara-saudara mereka sebangsa. {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan menaruh firman-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} di dalam mulutnya, dan ia akan menyampaikan kepada mereka segala yang {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} perintahkan kepadanya.
id.R: {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan memberikan kepada mereka seorang nabi seperti kamu dari antara bangsa mereka sendiri. {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan memberikan firman-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} kepadanya untuk diucapkan, dan ia akan memberitahukan kepada mereka segala yang {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} perintahkan kepadanya.

zh.L: 我要从他们的弟兄中为他们兴起一位先知，像你一样；我要把我的话放在他口中，他要把我所吩咐他的一切都告诉他们。
zh.B: 我要从他们的{{gender:同胞|弟兄}}中，为他们兴起一位像你一样的先知。我要把我的话放在他口中，他要把我吩咐他的一切转告他们。
zh.R: 我会从他们的同胞中给他们一位像你一样的先知。我会把我的话交给他去说，他会把我吩咐他的一切都告诉他们。

tl.L: Isang propeta ang ibabangon ko para sa kanila mula sa gitna ng kanilang mga kapatid, na gaya mo, at ilalagay ko ang aking mga salita sa kaniyang bibig, at sasabihin niya sa kanila ang lahat ng iuutos ko sa kaniya.
tl.B: Mula sa kanilang mga kababayan ay magbabangon ako para sa kanila ng isang propetang gaya mo. Ilalagay ko ang aking mga salita sa kaniyang bibig, at ipahahayag niya sa kanila ang lahat ng iuutos ko sa kaniya.
tl.R: Bibigyan ko sila ng isang propetang gaya mo mula sa kanilang sariling bayan. Ibibigay ko sa kaniya ang aking mga salitang sasabihin, at sasabihin niya sa kanila ang lahat ng iuutos ko sa kaniya.

pa.L: ਮੈਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਲਈ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਭਰਾਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰੋਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਰਗਾ ਇੱਕ ਨਬੀ ਖੜ੍ਹਾ ਕਰਾਂਗਾ, ਅਤੇ ਮੈਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਚਨ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਮੂੰਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਵਾਂਗਾ, ਅਤੇ ਜੋ ਕੁਝ ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੁਕਮ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਉਹ ਸਭ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਖੇਗਾ।
pa.B: ਮੈਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ {{gender:ਇਸਰਾਏਲੀ ਲੋਕਾਂ|ਭਰਾਵਾਂ}} ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਲਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਰਗਾ ਇੱਕ ਨਬੀ ਉਠਾਵਾਂਗਾ। ਮੈਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਚਨ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਮੂੰਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਵਾਂਗਾ, ਅਤੇ ਜੋ ਵੀ ਹੁਕਮ ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਦੇਵਾਂਗਾ ਉਹ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਤੱਕ ਪਹੁੰਚਾਵੇਗਾ।
pa.R: ਮੈਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਰਗਾ ਇੱਕ ਨਬੀ ਦਿਆਂਗਾ। ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਬੋਲਣ ਲਈ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਚਨ ਦਿਆਂਗਾ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਹ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਦੱਸੇਗਾ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੁਕਮ ਦਿਆਂ।

decisions.choice: a prophet ... like you: the promise of verse 15, now in the LORD's own words
decisions.reason: Moses passes on in verse 15 what the LORD said to him here. "Like you" means like Moses; see the note on verse 15.

decisions.choice: I will put my words in his mouth: I will give him the very words to speak
decisions.reason: The prophet does not speak his own thoughts but the LORD's words. The same picture is used of Aaron speaking for Moses (Exodus 4:15-16), of Balaam (Numbers 22:38; 23:5) and of Jeremiah's call (Jeremiah 1:9).

decisions.choice: he shall speak to them all that I command him: all of it, and nothing of his own
decisions.reason: The prophet must pass on the whole of what the LORD commands, and verse 20 shows he may add nothing to it. Moses himself did this (1:3; 4:2).

decisions.choice: their fellow Israelites / their own people
decisions.reason: As in verse 15. Balanced says "pass on to them" for "speak to them", since the words are the LORD's. Readable says "give him my words to say" for the picture of putting words in his mouth.

decisions.choice: "из их народа" with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in 18:15, "народ" already includes everyone and needs no gender span. In the LORD's speech (18:17-20) his "я" takes {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} mid-sentence, with "мои" and "меня", as elsewhere in this translation.

decisions.choice: 我的 (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: The English spans God's "my" and "me" (verses 18-20). Chinese has no reverent first person, so God's "我" takes no span, as the style guide says.

decisions.choice: "Isang propeta ... na gaya mo"
decisions.reason: The promise of verse 15, now in the LORD's own words (m1).

decisions.choice: "ilalagay ko ang aking mga salita sa kaniyang bibig" (L, B); "Ibibigay ko sa kaniya ang aking mga salitang sasabihin" (R)
decisions.reason: I will give him the very words to speak (m2).

decisions.choice: "ang lahat ng iuutos ko sa kaniya"
decisions.reason: All of it, and nothing of his own (m3).

decisions.choice: "mga kababayan" (B) with no gender span
decisions.reason: As English (en1); *kababayan* names no gender.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה הָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יִשְׁמַע֙ אֶל־דְּבָרַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְדַבֵּ֖ר בִּשְׁמִ֑י אָנֹכִ֖י אֶדְרֹ֥שׁ מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be [that] the man who not will listen to my words which he will speak in my name, I, I will require [it] from with him.

en.L: And it shall be [that] the {{gender:person|man}} who does not listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words that he speaks in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will require [it] of him.
en.B: If anyone does not listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words that the prophet speaks in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will hold that person responsible.
en.R: If anyone will not listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words when the prophet speaks for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will make that person answer to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Y sucederá [que] {{gender:la persona|el hombre}} que no escuche {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras que él hable en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, yo mismo se lo demandaré.
es.B: Si alguien no escucha {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras que el profeta hable en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, yo mismo le pediré cuentas a esa persona.
es.R: Si alguien no quiere escuchar {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras cuando el profeta hable de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} parte, yo mismo haré que esa persona {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} rinda cuentas.

fr.L: Et il arrivera [que] {{gender:la personne|l’homme}} qui n’écoutera pas {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles qu’il dira en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je lui en demanderai compte.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un n’écoute pas {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles que le prophète dira en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui lui en demanderai compte.
fr.R: Si quelqu’un refuse d’écouter {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles quand le prophète parle de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} part, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui lui demanderai des comptes.

sw.L: Na itakuwa [kwamba] mtu asiyesikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} atakayoyasema kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitamdai.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote asiyesikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ambayo nabii anayasema kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitamwajibisha.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote akikataa kusikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} nabii anaposema kwa niaba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitamfanya ajibu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra, người nào không nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà người ấy nói trong danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đòi [điều đó] nơi người ấy.
vi.B: Nếu ai không nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà nhà tiên tri nói nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bắt người ấy chịu trách nhiệm.
vi.R: Nếu ai không chịu nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khi nhà tiên tri nói thay cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bắt người ấy phải trả lời với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 내 이름으로 말하는 내 말을 듣지 않는 사람이 있으면, 내가 친히 그에게서 [그것을] 따질 것이다.
ko.B: 누구든지 그 예언자가 내 이름으로 전하는 내 말을 듣지 않으면, 내가 친히 그 사람에게 책임을 묻겠다.
ko.R: 누구든지 그 예언자가 나를 대신하여 전하는 내 말을 듣지 않으면, 내가 친히 그 사람에게 그 책임을 따지겠다.

pt.L: E será [que] {{gender:a pessoa|o homem}} que não ouvir as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras que ele falar em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, eu mesmo lhe pedirei contas.
pt.B: Se alguém não ouvir as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras que o profeta disser em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, eu mesmo pedirei contas a essa pessoa.
pt.R: Se alguém não quiser ouvir as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras quando o profeta falar por {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, eu mesmo vou fazer essa pessoa prestar contas a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

am.L: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በስሜ የሚናገረውን ቃሎቼን የማይሰማ ሰው፣ እኔ ራሴ እጠይቀዋለሁ።
am.B: ነቢዩ በስሜ የሚናገረውን ቃሌን የማይሰማ ማንም ቢኖር፣ እኔ ራሴ ተጠያቂ አደርገዋለሁ።
am.R: ነቢዩ ስለ እኔ ሆኖ ሲናገር ቃሌን የማይሰማ ማንም ቢኖር፣ እኔ ራሴ በፊቴ እንዲጠየቅ አደርገዋለሁ።

hi.L: और ऐसा होगा [कि] {{gender:जो व्यक्ति|जो पुरुष}} मेरे उन वचनों को न सुने जो वह मेरे नाम से कहेगा, उससे मैं स्वयं [उसका] हिसाब लूँगा।
hi.B: यदि कोई मेरे उन वचनों को न सुने जो वह भविष्यद्वक्ता मेरे नाम से कहेगा, तो मैं स्वयं उस व्यक्ति से उसका हिसाब लूँगा।
hi.R: जब वह नबी मेरी ओर से बोले, तब यदि कोई मेरे वचन न सुने, तो मैं स्वयं उस व्यक्ति से उसका हिसाब लूँगा।

ru.L: И будет: человек, который не послушает {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} слов, которые он будет говорить в {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя, — {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} взыщу с него.
ru.B: Если кто-то не послушает {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} слов, которые пророк скажет в {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сам призову этого человека к ответу.
ru.R: Если кто-то не будет слушать {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} слов, когда пророк говорит от {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} имени, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сам заставлю этого человека ответить передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}.

ja.L: そして、彼がわたしの名によって語るわたしの言葉に聞き従わない者がいれば、わたし自身がその者に[責任を]問う。
ja.B: その預言者がわたしの名によって語るわたしの言葉に聞き従わない者がいれば、わたし自身がその者に責任を問う。
ja.R: その預言者がわたしに代わって語るわたしの言葉を、聞こうとしない人がいれば、わたし自身がその人に責任を取らせる。

uk.L: І буде, що {{gender:людину, яка не слухатиме|чоловіка, який не слухатиме}} {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} слів, що він говоритиме в {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя, — я {{deity_pronoun:сам|Сам}} спитаю з {{gender:неї|нього}}.
uk.B: Якщо хтось не слухатиме {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} слів, які пророк говоритиме в {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя, я {{deity_pronoun:сам|Сам}} притягну цю людину до відповіді.
uk.R: Якщо хтось не захоче слухати {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} слів, коли пророк говоритиме від {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, я {{deity_pronoun:сам|Сам}} змушу цю людину відповісти переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}.

id.L: Dan akan terjadi, orang yang tidak mendengarkan firman-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} yang akan diucapkannya demi nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} sendiri akan menuntutnya dari padanya.
id.B: Siapa pun yang tidak mendengarkan firman-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} yang diucapkan nabi itu demi nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} sendiri akan meminta pertanggungjawaban dari orang itu.
id.R: Jika ada orang yang tidak mau mendengarkan firman-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} waktu nabi itu berbicara atas nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} sendiri akan membuat orang itu bertanggung jawab kepada-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.

zh.L: 那人若不听他奉我的名所说的我的话，我必亲自向他追讨。
zh.B: 若有人不听那先知奉我的名所说的我的话，我必亲自追究那人的责任。
zh.R: 如果有人在先知替我说话的时候不肯听我的话，我自己会叫那人向我交代。

tl.L: At mangyayari na {{gender:ang tao|ang lalaki}} na hindi makikinig sa aking mga salita na kaniyang sasabihin sa aking pangalan, ako mismo ang maniningil nito sa kaniya.
tl.B: Kung may hindi makikinig sa aking mga salitang sinasabi ng propeta sa aking pangalan, ako mismo ang magpapanagot sa taong iyon.
tl.R: Kung may ayaw makinig sa aking mga salita kapag nagsasalita ang propeta para sa akin, ako mismo ang magpapanagot sa taong iyon sa akin.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਇਉਂ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ ਕਿ ਜਿਹੜਾ {{gender:ਮਨੁੱਖ|ਆਦਮੀ}} ਮੇਰੇ ਬਚਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਾ ਸੁਣੇ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਉਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੋਲੇਗਾ, ਮੈਂ ਆਪ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ [ਲੇਖਾ] ਮੰਗਾਂਗਾ।
pa.B: ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਬਚਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਾ ਸੁਣੇ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਉਹ ਨਬੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੋਲੇਗਾ, ਤਾਂ ਮੈਂ ਆਪ ਉਸ ਬੰਦੇ ਤੋਂ ਜਵਾਬ ਮੰਗਾਂਗਾ।
pa.R: ਜਦ ਉਹ ਨਬੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਬੋਲੇ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਨਾ ਸੁਣੇ, ਤਾਂ ਮੈਂ ਆਪ ਉਸ ਬੰਦੇ ਤੋਂ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਲਵਾਂਗਾ।

decisions.choice: I will require it of him: I will hold him to account
decisions.reason: The verb means to seek or demand. Used against a person it means calling him to answer for a wrong, as God requires a life for a life in Genesis 9:5 and demands the blood of the lost from the careless watchman in Ezekiel 3:18. When Acts 3:23 quotes this verse, it gives the outcome in words from Leviticus 23:29: being cut off from the people.

decisions.choice: my words which he speaks in my name: the LORD's own words, spoken by the prophet with his authority
decisions.reason: To refuse the prophet is to refuse God, because the words are God's (verse 18).

decisions.choice: the man who does not listen: anyone, man or woman; and "I" is emphatic
decisions.reason: "The man" here means any person. The pronoun "I" is written out before the verb: the LORD himself will deal with the one who refuses.

decisions.choice: the person
decisions.reason: Literal says "the person", since anyone is meant, with "the man" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: If anyone ...; the prophet; hold that person responsible; when the prophet speaks for me
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the sentence into an "if" clause and name the prophet for "he". Readable says "speaks for me" for "speaks in my name".

decisions.choice: eu mesmo, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English puts "Myself" under the deity_pronoun setting. In Portuguese the emphasis (m3) falls on "eu", which takes no span for God (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 7), and "mesmo" is an adjective agreeing with it, not a pronoun, so it is written plainly. "Pedir contas" says the sense of "require it of him" (m1) at every level.

decisions.choice: "I will require it of him" as "እጠይቀዋለሁ" (L), "ተጠያቂ አደርገዋለሁ" (B, R), following the Hebrew rather than Acts 3:23
decisions.reason: Acts 3:23 quotes this verse in a different form ("ከሕዝቡ መካከል ፈጽሞ ይጠፋል", will be utterly destroyed from the people). The Hebrew says that God will hold the person to account, so the Amharic follows the Hebrew here. "ሰው" (L) already includes women, so the Amharic has no gender span.

decisions.choice: a gender span at Literal, "जो व्यक्ति" (setting: "जो पुरुष")
decisions.reason: The man who does not listen is anyone, man or woman (m3). Literal mirrors the English span; Balanced and Readable say "कोई" and "उस व्यक्ति", already inclusive.

decisions.choice: "者" with no gender span for {{gender:person|man}}
decisions.reason: Japanese "者" already covers anyone.

decisions.choice: 我必亲自向他追讨 (L), 追究那人的责任 (B), 叫那人向我交代 (R)
decisions.reason: Acts 3:23 quotes this verse in the Greek Old Testament's form, "will be utterly destroyed from among the people" (Chinese "从百姓当中被完全剪除"), drawing on Leviticus 23:29. The Hebrew says "I will require it of him" (m1), and the Chinese translates the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: 那人 (no gender span)
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span for "the man", since anyone is meant (m3); Chinese "人" is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: "ako mismo ang maniningil nito sa kaniya" (L); "ang magpapanagot" (B, R)
decisions.reason: I will hold him to account (m1).

decisions.choice: "na kaniyang sasabihin sa aking pangalan"; "ng propeta" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The LORD's own words, spoken by the prophet with his authority (m2), as English (en2).

decisions.choice: "ang tao" / "ang lalaki" (L span); "may ... ang taong iyon" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Anyone, man or woman; "ako mismo" is emphatic (m3), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: a gender span at Literal, "ਮਨੁੱਖ" (setting: "ਆਦਮੀ")
decisions.reason: The word for man here means any person.

source.text: אַ֣ךְ הַנָּבִ֡יא אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָזִיד֩ לְדַבֵּ֨ר דָּבָ֜ר בִּשְׁמִ֗י אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־צִוִּיתִיו֙ לְדַבֵּ֔ר וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יְדַבֵּ֔ר בְּשֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וּמֵ֖ת הַנָּבִ֥יא הַהֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: But the prophet who acts presumptuously to speak a word in my name that not I commanded him to speak, and who speaks in [the] name of other gods, and will die the prophet the that.

en.L: But the prophet who presumes to speak a word in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name that I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.'
en.B: But a prophet who dares to speak a word in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name that I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet must die.'
en.R: But suppose a prophet dares to say something in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name that I did not tell him to say, or he speaks for other gods. That prophet must die.'

es.L: Pero el profeta que tenga la presunción de hablar en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre una palabra que yo no le he mandado hablar, o que hable en nombre de otros dioses, ese profeta morirá”.
es.B: Pero el profeta que se atreva a decir en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre una palabra que yo no le he mandado decir, o que hable en nombre de otros dioses, ese profeta debe morir”.
es.R: Pero supongamos que un profeta se atreve a decir algo en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre que yo no le mandé decir, o que habla de parte de otros dioses. Ese profeta debe morir”.

fr.L: Mais le prophète qui aura la présomption de dire en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom une parole que je ne lui ai pas commandé de dire, ou qui parlera au nom d’autres dieux, ce prophète-là mourra.”
fr.B: Mais un prophète qui ose dire en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom une parole que je ne lui ai pas commandé de dire, ou qui parle au nom d’autres dieux, ce prophète doit mourir.”
fr.R: Mais imaginons qu’un prophète ose dire quelque chose en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom alors que je ne lui ai pas dit de le dire, ou qu’il parle de la part d’autres dieux. Ce prophète doit mourir.”

sw.L: Lakini nabii atakayethubutu kwa kiburi kusema neno kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ambalo sikumwamuru kulisema, au atakayesema kwa jina la miungu mingine, nabii huyo atakufa.'
sw.B: Lakini nabii atakayethubutu kusema neno kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ambalo sikumwamuru kulisema, au atakayesema kwa jina la miungu mingine, nabii huyo lazima afe.'
sw.R: Lakini tuseme nabii anathubutu kusema jambo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ambalo sikumwambia aseme, au anasema kwa niaba ya miungu mingine. Nabii huyo lazima afe.'

vi.L: Nhưng nhà tiên tri nào xấc xược nói một lời trong danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không truyền cho người ấy nói, hoặc nói trong danh các thần khác, thì nhà tiên tri ấy phải chết.'
vi.B: Còn nhà tiên tri nào dám nói nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một lời mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không truyền cho người ấy nói, hoặc nói nhân danh các thần khác, thì nhà tiên tri ấy phải chết.'
vi.R: Nhưng giả sử một nhà tiên tri dám nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không bảo người ấy nói, hoặc nói thay cho các thần khác. Nhà tiên tri ấy phải chết.'

ko.L: 그러나 내가 말하라고 명령하지 않은 말을 감히 내 이름으로 말하거나, 다른 신들의 이름으로 말하는 예언자가 있으면, 그 예언자는 죽어야 한다.'
ko.B: 그러나 내가 명령하지 않은 말을 감히 내 이름으로 전하거나, 다른 신들의 이름으로 말하는 예언자는 죽어야 한다.'
ko.R: 그러나 어떤 예언자가 내가 말하라고 하지 않은 것을 감히 내 이름으로 말하거나, 다른 신들을 대신하여 말하면, 그 예언자는 죽어야 한다.'

pt.L: Mas o profeta que tiver a presunção de falar em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome uma palavra que eu não lhe ordenei falar, ou que falar em nome de outros deuses, esse profeta morrerá.'
pt.B: Mas o profeta que ousar dizer em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome uma palavra que eu não lhe mandei dizer, ou que falar em nome de outros deuses, esse profeta deverá morrer.'
pt.R: Mas pode ser que um profeta tenha a ousadia de dizer alguma coisa em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome que eu não mandei que ele dissesse, ou que fale em nome de outros deuses. Esse profeta deve morrer.'

am.L: ነገር ግን እንዲናገር ያላዘዝኩትን ቃል በስሜ ለመናገር የሚደፍር፣ ወይም በሌሎች አማልክት ስም የሚናገር ነቢይ፣ ያ ነቢይ ይሙት።”
am.B: ነገር ግን እንዲናገር ያላዘዝኩትን ቃል በስሜ ለመናገር የሚደፍር ወይም በሌሎች አማልክት ስም የሚናገር ነቢይ ይገደል።”
am.R: ነገር ግን አንድ ነቢይ እንዲናገር ያላዘዝኩትን ነገር በስሜ ለመናገር ይደፍር ይሆናል፤ ወይም ስለ ሌሎች አማልክት ሆኖ ይናገር ይሆናል። ያ ነቢይ መገደል አለበት።”

hi.L: परंतु जो भविष्यद्वक्ता ढिठाई करके मेरे नाम से कोई ऐसा वचन कहे जिसके कहने की आज्ञा मैंने उसे नहीं दी, या जो दूसरे देवताओं के नाम से कुछ कहे, वह भविष्यद्वक्ता मर जाए।'
hi.B: परंतु जो भविष्यद्वक्ता दुस्साहस करके मेरे नाम से कोई ऐसा वचन कहे जिसके कहने की आज्ञा मैंने उसे नहीं दी, या जो दूसरे देवताओं के नाम से बोले, वह भविष्यद्वक्ता मार डाला जाए।'
hi.R: पर हो सकता है कि कोई नबी दुस्साहस करके मेरे नाम से कुछ ऐसा कहे जो कहने के लिए मैंने उससे नहीं कहा, या वह दूसरे देवताओं की ओर से बोले। उस नबी को मार डाला जाए।'

ru.L: А пророк, который дерзнёт говорить слово в {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя, которого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не повелел ему говорить, или который будет говорить во имя других богов, — тот пророк пусть умрёт.”
ru.B: Но пророк, который осмелится сказать в {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя слово, которого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не повелел ему говорить, или который будет говорить во имя других богов, — этот пророк должен умереть.”
ru.R: Но пророк может осмелиться сказать от {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} имени то, чего {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не велел ему говорить, или говорить от имени других богов. Такой пророк должен умереть.”

ja.L: しかし、わたしが語るように命じていない言葉を、思い上がってわたしの名によって語る預言者、あるいは、ほかの神々の名によって語る[預言者]、その預言者は死ななければならない。』
ja.B: しかし、わたしが語るように命じていない言葉を、あえてわたしの名によって語る預言者や、ほかの神々の名によって語る預言者は、死ななければならない。』
ja.R: けれども、わたしが語るように言っていないことを、勝手にわたしの名によって語る預言者がいるかもしれない。あるいは、ほかの神々のために語る預言者がいるかもしれない。そのような預言者は死ななければならない。』

uk.L: Але пророк, який зухвало говоритиме слово в {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя, якого я не наказував йому говорити, або який говоритиме в імʼя інших богів, — той пророк помре.”
uk.B: Але пророк, який насмілиться сказати слово в {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя, якого я не наказував йому говорити, або який говоритиме в імʼя інших богів, — той пророк мусить померти.”
uk.R: Але може статися, що пророк насмілиться сказати щось у {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя, чого я не велів йому казати, або говоритиме від інших богів. Той пророк мусить померти.”

id.L: Tetapi nabi yang berlaku angkuh untuk mengucapkan demi nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} perkataan yang tidak {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} perintahkan kepadanya untuk diucapkan, atau yang berbicara demi nama allah-allah lain, nabi itu harus mati.'
id.B: Tetapi nabi yang berani mengucapkan demi nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} perkataan yang tidak {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} perintahkan kepadanya, atau yang berbicara demi nama allah-allah lain, nabi itu harus mati.'
id.R: Tetapi mungkin ada nabi yang berani mengatakan sesuatu atas nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, padahal {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} tidak menyuruhnya mengatakan hal itu, atau ia berbicara atas nama allah-allah lain. Nabi itu harus mati.'

zh.L: 但那擅自奉我的名说我没有吩咐他说的话的先知，或奉别的神明的名说话的，那先知就要死。’
zh.B: 但如果有先知擅自奉我的名，说我没有吩咐他说的话，或奉别的神明的名说话，那先知就必须死。’
zh.R: 但是如果有先知胆敢奉我的名，说我没有叫他说的话，或替别的神明说话，那个先知就必须处死。’

tl.L: Ngunit ang propetang mangangahas magsalita ng salita sa aking pangalan na hindi ko iniutos sa kaniya na sabihin, o ang nagsasalita sa pangalan ng ibang mga diyos, ang propetang iyon ay mamamatay.'
tl.B: Ngunit ang propetang mangahas magsalita sa aking pangalan ng salitang hindi ko iniutos sa kaniya na sabihin, o nagsasalita sa pangalan ng ibang mga diyos, ay dapat mamatay.'
tl.R: Ngunit ipagpalagay na may propetang nangahas magsabi ng isang bagay sa aking pangalan na hindi ko iniutos sa kaniya na sabihin, o nagsalita siya para sa ibang mga diyos. Dapat mamatay ang propetang iyon.'

pa.L: ਪਰ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਨਬੀ ਹੰਕਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਅਜਿਹੀ ਗੱਲ ਬੋਲੇ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਬੋਲਣ ਦਾ ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੁਕਮ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਿੱਤਾ, ਜਾਂ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਦੂਜੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੋਲੇ, ਉਹ ਨਬੀ ਮਰ ਜਾਵੇ।'
pa.B: ਪਰ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਨਬੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਅਜਿਹੀ ਗੱਲ ਆਖਣ ਦੀ ਗੁਸਤਾਖ਼ੀ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੁਕਮ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਿੱਤਾ, ਜਾਂ ਹੋਰ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੋਲੇ, ਉਸ ਨਬੀ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਵੇ।'
pa.R: ਪਰ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਨਬੀ ਹਿੰਮਤ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਹ ਗੱਲ ਆਖੇ ਜਿਹੜੀ ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸੀ, ਜਾਂ ਹੋਰ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਬੋਲੇ, ਤਾਂ ਉਹ ਨਬੀ ਜ਼ਰੂਰ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਵੇ।'

decisions.choice: presumes: acts boldly and arrogantly, going beyond what he is allowed
decisions.reason: The verb is used of Israel going up to fight against the LORD's word (1:43) and of a man who will not obey the priest or judge (17:12-13). Here the prophet claims to speak for God when God has not sent him. The noun from the same root closes verse 22.

decisions.choice: and who speaks in the name of other gods: a second kind of false prophet
decisions.reason: Two cases are named: one who speaks in the LORD's name what the LORD has not said, and one who speaks for other gods, the case of 13:2-6.

decisions.choice: that prophet shall die: he deserves death
decisions.reason: The verb is the plain "die" and does not say who brings about the death. 13:6 commands the people to put a prophet who calls them to other gods to death; in Jeremiah 28:15-17 the LORD himself brings death on the false prophet Hananiah.

decisions.choice: the closing single quotation mark
decisions.reason: The LORD's words, opened in verse 17, end here. Moses speaks again in verse 21, where the LORD is spoken of in the third person.

decisions.choice: "mangangahas"
decisions.reason: Acts boldly and arrogantly, going beyond what he is allowed (m1).

decisions.choice: "o ang nagsasalita sa pangalan ng ibang mga diyos"
decisions.reason: A second kind of false prophet (m2).

decisions.choice: "ay mamamatay"; closing single quotation mark
decisions.reason: He deserves death (m3); the LORD's words end here, as English (en1).

source.text: וְכִ֥י תֹאמַ֖ר בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ אֵיכָה֙ נֵדַ֣ע אֶת־הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־דִבְּר֖וֹ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And if you say in your heart, How will we know the word which not has spoken it Yahweh?

en.L: And if you say in your heart, 'How shall we know the word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has not spoken?'
en.B: You may wonder, 'How are we to recognize a word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has not spoken?'
en.R: You may ask yourself, 'How can we tell if a message did not come from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?'

es.L: Y si dices en tu corazón: “¿Cómo conoceremos la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha hablado?”
es.B: Quizá te preguntes: “¿Cómo vamos a reconocer una palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha dicho?”
es.R: Tal vez te preguntes: “¿Cómo podemos saber si un mensaje no vino {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?”

fr.L: Et si tu dis dans ton cœur : “Comment connaîtrons-nous la parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas dite ?”
fr.B: Tu te demanderas peut-être : “Comment reconnaîtrons-nous une parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas dite ?”
fr.R: Tu te demandes peut-être : “Comment savoir si un message ne vient pas {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ?”

sw.L: Na ukisema moyoni mwako, 'Tutalijuaje neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakulisema?'
sw.B: Huenda ukajiuliza, 'Tutalitambuaje neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakulisema?'
sw.R: Huenda ukajiuliza, 'Tunawezaje kujua kama ujumbe haukutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?'

vi.L: Và nếu ngươi nói trong lòng: 'Làm sao chúng ta biết được lời mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không phán?'
vi.B: Có thể anh em tự hỏi: 'Làm sao chúng ta nhận biết được lời nào không phải do {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán?'
vi.R: Có thể anh em tự hỏi: 'Làm sao chúng ta biết được một sứ điệp không đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?'

ko.L: 그리고 네가 마음속으로 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하지 않으신 말씀을 우리가 어떻게 알 수 있겠는가?' 하고 말한다면,
ko.B: 너희는 속으로 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하지 않으신 말씀을 우리가 어떻게 알아볼 수 있을까?' 하고 물을지도 모른다.
ko.R: 여러분은 '어떤 말이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀이 아닌지 우리가 어떻게 알 수 있을까?' 하고 궁금해할 수도 있습니다.

pt.L: E, se disseres no teu coração: 'Como conheceremos a palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não falou?'
pt.B: Talvez perguntes a ti mesmo: 'Como vamos reconhecer uma palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não falou?'
pt.R: Podes te perguntar: 'Como vamos saber se uma mensagem não veio {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?'

am.L: በልብህም “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ያልተናገረውን ቃል እንዴት እናውቃለን?” ብትል፣
am.B: “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ያልተናገረውን ቃል እንዴት ልናውቅ እንችላለን?” ብለህ ታስብ ይሆናል።
am.R: “አንድ መልእክት {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} እንዳልመጣ እንዴት ልናውቅ እንችላለን?” ብለህ ራስህን ትጠይቅ ይሆናል።

hi.L: और यदि तुम अपने मन में कहो, 'हम उस वचन को कैसे पहचानें जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने नहीं कहा?'
hi.B: शायद तुम मन में सोचो, 'हम कैसे पहचानें कि कौन-सा वचन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने नहीं कहा?'
hi.R: शायद तुम अपने आप से पूछो, 'हम कैसे जानें कि कोई संदेश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से नहीं आया?'

ru.L: И если скажешь в своём сердце: “Как нам узнать слово, которого не говорил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}?”
ru.B: Ты можешь спросить себя: “Как нам распознать слово, которого не говорил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}?”
ru.R: Ты можешь спросить себя: “Как нам понять, что весть пришла не от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}?”

ja.L: また、もしあなたが心の中で、『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語られなかった言葉を、わたしたちはどのようにして知ることができるのか？』と言うなら、
ja.B: あなたは、『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語られなかった言葉を、わたしたちはどうやって見分けたらよいのか？』と思うかもしれない。
ja.R: あなたは、『その言葉が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から出たものでないことを、わたしたちはどうしたら見分けられるのか？』と思うかもしれない。

uk.L: А якщо скажеш у своєму серці: “Як ми розпізнаємо слово, якого {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не говорив?”
uk.B: Ти можеш подумати: “Як нам розпізнати слово, якого {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не говорив?”
uk.R: Ти можеш спитати себе: “Як нам дізнатися, що звістка не від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}?”

id.L: Dan apabila engkau berkata dalam hatimu, 'Bagaimanakah kami mengetahui perkataan yang tidak difirmankan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}?'
id.B: Mungkin engkau bertanya dalam hati, 'Bagaimana kami dapat mengenali perkataan yang tidak difirmankan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}?'
id.R: Mungkin kalian bertanya dalam hati, 'Bagaimana kami dapat tahu bahwa suatu pesan tidak berasal dari {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}?'

zh.L: 你若心里说：‘我们怎能知道哪句话是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}没有说过的呢？’
zh.B: 你也许会想：‘我们怎样才能辨别哪句话不是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}说的呢？’
zh.R: 你可能会问自己：‘我们怎么能知道一个信息不是从{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}来的呢？’

tl.L: At kung sabihin mo sa iyong puso, 'Paano namin malalaman ang salitang hindi sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}?'
tl.B: Maaaring itanong ninyo, 'Paano namin makikilala ang salitang hindi sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}?'
tl.R: Maaaring itanong ninyo sa inyong sarili, 'Paano namin malalaman kung ang isang mensahe ay hindi mula {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}}?'

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਿਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਖੇਂ, 'ਅਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਬਚਨ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਜਾਣਾਂਗੇ ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੋਲਿਆ?'
pa.B: ਸ਼ਾਇਦ ਤੂੰ ਸੋਚੇਂ, 'ਅਸੀਂ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਪਛਾਣੀਏ ਕਿ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਬਚਨ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੋਲਿਆ?'
pa.R: ਤੂੰ ਸ਼ਾਇਦ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੁੱਛੇਂ, 'ਸਾਨੂੰ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਪਤਾ ਲੱਗੇ ਕਿ ਕੋਈ ਸੁਨੇਹਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਵੱਲੋਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਇਆ?'

decisions.choice: say in your heart: ask yourself, think
decisions.reason: To "say in the heart" is to think a thing without saying it aloud (7:17; 8:17; 9:4).

decisions.choice: the word: a message claimed to be from the LORD
decisions.reason: The same noun means both "word" and "thing" or "event". Verse 22 makes use of both senses: a word from the LORD is shown to be his when the thing it speaks of comes about.

decisions.choice: you say ... we know: the singular "you" asks for all
decisions.reason: The question is put in the mouth of each Israelite (singular "you") but asks for the whole people ("we").

decisions.choice: You may wonder / ask yourself; recognize; message
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of "say in your heart". Readable says "message" for "word", since a spoken message from a prophet is meant; Balanced keeps "word".

decisions.choice: "sabihin mo sa iyong puso" (L); "itanong ninyo" (B); "itanong ninyo sa inyong sarili" (R)
decisions.reason: Ask yourself, think (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "salita" (L, B); "mensahe" (R)
decisions.reason: A message claimed to be from the LORD (m2), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "mo ... namin"
decisions.reason: The singular "you" asks for all (m3); *namin* because the people speak to Moses about the LORD.

source.text: אֲשֶׁר֩ יְדַבֵּ֨ר הַנָּבִ֜יא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֤ה הַדָּבָר֙ וְלֹ֣א יָב֔וֹא ה֣וּא הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־דִבְּר֖וֹ יְהוָ֑ה בְּזָדוֹן֙ דִּבְּר֣וֹ הַנָּבִ֔יא לֹ֥א תָג֖וּר מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: That which speaks the prophet in [the] name of Yahweh, and not happens the thing and not comes, it [is] the word which not has spoken it Yahweh; in presumption has spoken it the prophet; not you shall be afraid of him.

en.L: What the prophet speaks in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the thing does not happen and does not come [about], that [is] the word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has not spoken; in presumption the prophet has spoken it; you shall not be afraid of him.
en.B: When a prophet speaks in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and his word does not happen or come true, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did not speak that word. The prophet spoke it presumptuously; do not be afraid of him.
en.R: If a prophet says something in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s name and it does not happen or come true, then that message did not come from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. The prophet spoke without any right to do so. Do not be afraid of him.

es.L: Lo que el profeta hable en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y la cosa no suceda ni se cumpla, esa [es] la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha hablado; con presunción la ha hablado el profeta; no tendrás temor de él.
es.B: Cuando un profeta hable en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y su palabra no suceda ni se cumpla, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no habló esa palabra. El profeta la dijo con presunción; no le tengas miedo.
es.R: Si un profeta dice algo en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y no sucede ni se cumple, entonces ese mensaje no vino {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. El profeta habló sin tener ningún derecho a hacerlo. No le tengas miedo.

fr.L: Ce que le prophète dit au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et que la chose n’arrive pas et ne se réalise pas, c’est la parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas dite ; c’est par présomption que le prophète l’a dite ; tu n’auras pas peur de lui.
fr.B: Quand un prophète parle au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et que sa parole ne s’accomplit pas et ne se réalise pas, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas dit cette parole. Le prophète l’a dite avec présomption ; n’aie pas peur de lui.
fr.R: Si un prophète dit quelque chose au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et que cela n’arrive pas, que cela ne se réalise pas, alors ce message ne vient pas {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Le prophète a parlé sans en avoir le droit. N’aie pas peur de lui.

sw.L: Lile ambalo nabii atasema kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na jambo hilo lisitokee wala lisitimie, hilo [ndilo] neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakulisema; kwa kiburi nabii amelisema; usimwogope.
sw.B: Nabii anaposema kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na neno lake lisitokee wala lisitimie, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakulisema neno hilo. Nabii huyo alilisema kwa kiburi; usimwogope.
sw.R: Nabii akisema jambo kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na jambo hilo lisitokee wala lisitimie, basi ujumbe huo haukutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nabii huyo alisema bila kuwa na mamlaka ya kufanya hivyo. Usimwogope.

vi.L: Điều nhà tiên tri nói trong danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà việc ấy không xảy ra và không đến, thì đó [là] lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không phán; nhà tiên tri đã nói điều ấy cách xấc xược; ngươi chớ sợ người ấy.
vi.B: Khi một nhà tiên tri nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà nói, và lời ấy không xảy ra hay không thành sự thật, thì đó không phải là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Nhà tiên tri ấy đã nói cách xấc xược; đừng sợ người ấy.
vi.R: Nếu một nhà tiên tri nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nói điều gì mà điều ấy không xảy ra hay không thành sự thật, thì sứ điệp ấy không đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Nhà tiên tri ấy đã nói mà không có quyền gì để nói. Đừng sợ người ấy.

ko.L: 예언자가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 말하였는데 그 일이 이루어지지 않고 일어나지 않으면, 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하지 않으신 말씀이다. 그 예언자가 교만하여 그것을 말한 것이니, 너는 그를 두려워하지 말라.
ko.B: 어떤 예언자가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 말했는데 그 말이 이루어지지 않고 그대로 일어나지 않으면, 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀이 아니다. 그 예언자가 제멋대로 말한 것이니, 너희는 그를 두려워하지 말라.
ko.R: 어떤 예언자가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 말했는데 그 일이 일어나지 않거나 그대로 되지 않으면, 그 말은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 것이 아닙니다. 그 예언자는 아무런 권한도 없이 말한 것입니다. 그를 두려워하지 마십시오.

pt.L: Quando o profeta falar em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e a coisa não acontecer nem se cumprir, essa [é] a palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não falou; com presunção o profeta a falou; não terás medo dele.
pt.B: Quando um profeta falar em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e a sua palavra não acontecer nem se cumprir, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não falou essa palavra. O profeta falou com presunção; não terás medo dele.
pt.R: Se um profeta disser alguma coisa em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e isso não acontecer nem se cumprir, então essa mensagem não veio {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. O profeta falou sem ter nenhum direito de falar. Não tenhas medo dele.

am.L: ነቢዩ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም የሚናገረው፣ ነገሩም ባይሆን ባይመጣም፣ ያ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ያልተናገረው ቃል ነው፤ ነቢዩ በትዕቢት ተናግሮታል፤ እርሱን አትፍራ።
am.B: አንድ ነቢይ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም ተናግሮ ቃሉ ባይፈጸም ወይም እውነት ሆኖ ባይገኝ፣ ያን ቃል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አልተናገረውም። ነቢዩ በትዕቢት ተናግሮታል፤ እርሱን አትፍራ።
am.R: አንድ ነቢይ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም አንድ ነገር ተናግሮ ያ ነገር ባይሆን ወይም እውነት ሆኖ ባይገኝ፣ ያ መልእክት {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} አልመጣም። ነቢዩ ምንም መብት ሳይኖረው ተናገረ። እርሱን አትፍራ።

hi.L: जो कुछ वह भविष्यद्वक्ता {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से कहे, और वह बात न हो और [पूरी] न हो, तो वह वचन वही [है] जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने नहीं कहा; उस भविष्यद्वक्ता ने उसे ढिठाई से कहा है; तुम उससे न डरना।
hi.B: जब कोई भविष्यद्वक्ता {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से कुछ कहे और वह बात न हो और पूरी न हो, तो वह वचन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने नहीं कहा। उस भविष्यद्वक्ता ने उसे ढिठाई से कहा है; उससे न डरना।
hi.R: यदि कोई नबी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से कुछ कहे और वह न हो या पूरा न हो, तो वह संदेश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से नहीं आया। उस नबी ने बिना किसी अधिकार के वह बात कही। उससे न डरना।

ru.L: Что скажет пророк во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, а дело не сбудется и не исполнится, — это слово, которого не говорил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}; по дерзости говорил его пророк; не бойся его.
ru.B: Если пророк говорит во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, а его слово не сбывается и не исполняется, значит, это слово сказал не {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Пророк сказал его по своей дерзости; не бойся его.
ru.R: Если пророк говорит что-то от имени {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, а это не происходит и не сбывается, значит, эта весть пришла не от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Пророк говорил, не имея на это права. Не бойся его.

ja.L: 預言者が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって語っても、その事が起こらず、実現しないなら、それは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語られなかった言葉である。その預言者は思い上がってそれを語ったのである。あなたは彼を恐れてはならない。
ja.B: 預言者が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって語っても、その言葉が起こらず、実現しないなら、それは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語られた言葉ではない。その預言者は思い上がって語ったのである。彼を恐れてはならない。
ja.R: 預言者が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって何かを言っても、そのとおりに起こらず、実現しないなら、その言葉は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から出たものではない。その預言者は、勝手に語ったのである。その預言者をこわがってはいけない。

uk.L: Те, що пророк скаже в імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, а та річ не станеться й не прийде, — це слово, якого {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не говорив; зухвало говорив його пророк; не бійся його.
uk.B: Коли пророк говорить в імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, а його слово не станеться й не справдиться, то {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не говорив того слова. Пророк сказав його зухвало; не бійся його.
uk.R: Якщо пророк скаже щось в імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, а воно не станеться й не справдиться, то ця звістка не від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Пророк говорив без жодного права на це. Не бійся його.

id.L: Apabila seorang nabi berbicara demi nama {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, dan perkataan itu tidak terjadi dan tidak datang, itulah perkataan yang tidak difirmankan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}; dengan angkuh nabi itu telah mengucapkannya; janganlah engkau takut kepadanya.
id.B: Apabila seorang nabi berbicara demi nama {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, lalu perkataannya tidak terjadi dan tidak menjadi kenyataan, perkataan itu bukan difirmankan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}. Nabi itu mengucapkannya dengan lancang; jangan takut kepadanya.
id.R: Jika seorang nabi mengatakan sesuatu atas nama {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, lalu hal itu tidak terjadi atau tidak menjadi kenyataan, pesan itu tidak berasal dari {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}. Nabi itu berbicara tanpa hak untuk melakukannya. Jangan takut kepadanya.

zh.L: 先知奉{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的名所说的，若那事没有发生，也没有成就，那就是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}没有说过的话；那先知是擅自说的，你不要怕他。
zh.B: 如果先知奉{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的名说话，他的话却没有发生，也没有应验，那话就不是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}说的。那先知是擅自说的，你不要怕他。
zh.R: 如果有先知奉{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的名说了一件事，那件事却没有发生，也没有成真，那么那个信息就不是从{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}来的。那先知根本没有权利这样说。不要怕他。

tl.L: Ang sinasabi ng propeta sa pangalan {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, at ang bagay ay hindi nangyari at hindi dumating, iyon ang salitang hindi sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}; sa kapalaluan ito sinabi ng propeta; huwag kang matatakot sa kaniya.
tl.B: Kapag nagsalita ang isang propeta sa pangalan {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} at hindi nangyari o natupad ang kaniyang salita, hindi sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} ang salitang iyon. Sinabi iyon ng propeta nang may kapalaluan; huwag kayong matakot sa kaniya.
tl.R: Kung may sinabi ang isang propeta sa pangalan {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} at hindi iyon nangyari o natupad, hindi mula {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}} ang mensaheng iyon. Nagsalita ang propeta nang walang anumang karapatan. Huwag kayong matakot sa kaniya.

pa.L: ਜੋ ਨਬੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੋਲੇ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਗੱਲ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਅਤੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ, ਉਹ ਉਹ ਬਚਨ [ਹੈ] ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੋਲਿਆ; ਨਬੀ ਨੇ ਉਹ ਹੰਕਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਹੈ; ਤੂੰ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਨਾ ਡਰੀਂ।
pa.B: ਜਦ ਕੋਈ ਨਬੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੋਲੇ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਨਾ ਵਾਪਰੇ ਨਾ ਸੱਚੀ ਨਿੱਕਲੇ, ਤਾਂ ਉਹ ਬਚਨ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਹੀਂ। ਉਸ ਨਬੀ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਗੁਸਤਾਖ਼ੀ ਨਾਲ ਉਹ ਕਿਹਾ ਹੈ; ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਨਾ ਡਰੀਂ।
pa.R: ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਨਬੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੁਝ ਆਖੇ ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਨਾ ਵਾਪਰੇ ਜਾਂ ਸੱਚ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ, ਤਾਂ ਉਹ ਸੁਨੇਹਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਵੱਲੋਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੀ। ਉਸ ਨਬੀ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਆਖਣ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੱਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੀ। ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਨਾ ਡਰੀਂ।

decisions.choice: the thing ... the word: the same noun, the event and the message
decisions.reason: The noun of verse 21 appears twice: "the thing" that does not happen and "the word" the LORD has not spoken. If what was spoken does not come about, the word was not the LORD's.

decisions.choice: does not happen: a failed word shows a false prophet, but a word that comes true is not enough by itself
decisions.reason: This test shows when a prophet has not been sent. 13:2-4 adds that even a sign that comes true does not make a prophet true if he calls Israel to other gods. A true prophet must speak in the LORD's name, call Israel to the LORD alone, and see his word come about.

decisions.choice: in presumption: from his own arrogance, not from the LORD
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb of verse 20. The prophet spoke boldly on his own authority.

decisions.choice: you shall not be afraid of him: do not hold him in awe or fear his threats
decisions.reason: A prophet's words could be frightening, as warnings of disaster were. Israel need not fear the words of one the LORD has not sent, nor fear to act against him.

decisions.choice: the LORD did not speak that word; spoke without any right to do so
decisions.reason: Balanced puts "the word that the LORD has not spoken" as a plain statement. Readable explains "in presumption": the prophet had no right to speak for the LORD.

decisions.choice: "ang bagay ... ang salita"
decisions.reason: The same noun, the event and the message (m1).

decisions.choice: "hindi nangyari"
decisions.reason: A failed word shows a false prophet, but a word that comes true is not enough by itself (m2).

decisions.choice: "sa kapalaluan" (L); "nang may kapalaluan" (B); "nang walang anumang karapatan" (R)
decisions.reason: From his own arrogance, not from the LORD (m3), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "huwag kang matatakot sa kaniya"
decisions.reason: Do not hold him in awe or fear his threats (m4).
